 På Trafikverket jobbar vi med att göra Sverige närmare. Vi tror på att en förening av olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv är den bästa grunden för att bygga en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering och en miljö där alla trivs och gör sitt bästa. Vi tror på mångfald där den gemensamma nämnaren är pålitlighet, engagemang och mod. För det är så vi bäst representerar vårt samhälle.

title: Product Owner Platform Engineering Getinge Critical Care
description:
**With a passion for life**
 Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
   

  

 Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
   

  

**About This Opportunity**
 We are looking for a technically hands-on Product Owner for our Platform Engineering team at our Solna site. You will own the roadmap and backlog for the platform that enables our product teams to design, build, test and deliver software efficiently.
   

  

 You will work closely with product teams, engineering, security, compliance, and other internal stakeholders to improve the full software delivery lifecycle. GitLab is a central component of the platform, together with Kubernetes, Azure, on-prem infrastructure, and observability tooling based on the LGTM stack. The role requires a high degree of autonomy – you should be self-driven, identify needs, prioritize work, and implement improvements together with your team with limited day-to-day guidance.
   

  

 A key part of the role is to provide AI-related services, tooling, and support for both technical and non-technical users, with a strong focus on improving developer experience, productivity, and collaboration.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and manage the roadmap and backlog for the internal software development platform, combined with hands-on technical work.
* Collaborate with product teams, security, compliance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, and easy to use.
* Provide AI services, guidance, and support to improve developer experience and productivity for both technical and non-technical users.
* Support product teams with onboarding, integrations, testing workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and platform adoption.


 This position is based in Solna, Sweden and is eligible for a hybrid work setup.
   

  

**You will bring**
 To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, or equivalent working experience.
* Some years of experience in product ownership or a similar role, together with hands-on experience of cloud/hybrid infrastructure (Azure, on-prem) and Kubernetes, including application deployments and/or CI workload execution.
* Experience with GitLab or similar source control and CI/CD platforms, and with AI developer tools and/or AI platforms (e.g. GitLab Duo, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Azure OpenAI).
* Understanding of security, compliance, governance and auditability in software development environments.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to different audiences.
* Fluent in Swedish and English, orally and written.
* Experience with secure software supply chain practices (dependency scanning, container scanning, SAST, secret detection, vulnerability management), the LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir), and/or working in regulated or compliance-driven environments is meritorious.


 In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. You are self-driven and comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy, identifying needs and prioritizing your own work with limited day-to-day guidance.
   

  

 We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest platform engineering and AI developer tooling. At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers. We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.
   

  

**Why join Getinge**
 Getinge offers a job in a safe and informal work environment, where we appreciate close team collaboration. We keep an open dialogue between leaders and employees, as well as between teams. We are focused on developing people, and together we will create a plan for learning and competence development when you start your career with us.
   

  

 We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.
   

  

**Application**
 Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-05.
   

  

 We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Hiring Manager Fredrik Ågren at email: fredrik.agren@getinge.com , or Talent Manager Emma Paulsson at email: emma.paulsson@getinge.com
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.
   

  

**About Us**
 With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
description:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.
   

  

 As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.
* Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.
* Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.
* Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.
* Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.
* Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.
* Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.
* Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.
* You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.
* You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.
* You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.
* You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.
* You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.
* You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.
* Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in New York or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 The United States base range for this position is $248,656 - $355,223, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Senior Backend Platform Engineer
description:
Open position
   

  

 Senior Backend Platform Engineer
   

  

**About Us**
 We build software that makes governance, risk, and compliance approachable: turning dense regulatory frameworks and internal policy into something organizations can work with. AI is central to how we do that, surfacing the right information, making sense of complex documents, and keeping outputs trustworthy in a domain where accuracy matters.
   

  

 We were founded by Magnus Juvas, serial entrepreneur behind Solidify and Transcendent Group, and Emelie Alftrén, with over two decades in risk management and governance. Two people who had seen the problem from both sides and decided to solve it properly.
   

  

 We're early-stage, meaning the foundations are in place but there's plenty left to shape. You'll have real ownership over both what you build and how it evolves. We're based in Stockholm and work hybrid.
   

  

 Joining Nooga means three things.
   

  

**Own it:** 
 we take responsibility and act. If you see a problem, you step up.
   

  

**Challenge the norm:** 
 we don't build things the way they've always been built. We build them better.
   

  

**Succeed together:** 
 with each other, and with our customers.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 You'll own the platform that everything else runs on: infrastructure, automation, Kubernetes, and Azure, defined in Terraform, operated with discipline, and evolved with intention. You treat the platform as a product: clean developer experience, reliable operations, and security that's built in rather than bolted on.
   

  

 You'll start with a clear focus on Navigator (our core product) and grow from there as the company scales. You'll own both the operational and security dimensions of the platform, and you'll be the person who makes sure we're running things correctly, not just running them. You're comfortable enough in application code to collaborate closely with the backend team, but the platform is where you want to be.
   

  

 What You'll Work On
   

  

* Terraform modules that define, provision, and evolve tenant infrastructure on AKS
* Deployment pipelines and the workflows that ship and manage services across tenants
* AKS cluster operations: node pools, autoscaling, ingress (Front Door + WAF), and day-to-day reliability
* Security and identity: Workload Identity, Key Vault integration, zero-credential service auth, and least-privilege across the platform
* Networking: VNets, subnets, private endpoints, private DNS, TLS
* Docker base-image strategy, CI build pipelines, and image hygiene
* Observability: log routing, health checks, alerting, and metrics, built to be useful during incidents, not just present
* Evolving the platform beyond Navigator as the company grows: automation, standardisation, and broader infrastructure ownership


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5+ years of platform, SRE, or infrastructure work running production Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE, or on-prem)
* Strong Terraform: modules, remote state, drift management, and a track record of teams actually using the IaC you write
* Solid cloud operations experience: comfortable managing infrastructure in a cloud environment, with attention to cost, security, and scale. We run on Azure; experience on AWS or GCP transfers well
* Solid networking fundamentals: VNets/VPCs, private endpoints, DNS, ingress, TLS
* Container fundamentals: multi-stage Dockerfiles, base-image strategy, build discipline, image security
* Security mindset woven into platform work, not a separate concern
* Helm and/or Kustomize; comfortable with raw manifests when needed
* Opinionated about platform quality, but grounded in what the teams using the platform actually need
* Comfortable reading and debugging Python/Celery application code, enough to collaborate effectively and unblock yourself


 Helpful But Not Required
   

  

* Azure specifically (AKS, Front Door, Workload Identity, Private DNS, AI Foundry)
* Multi-tenant SaaS platform experience
* PostgreSQL extensions (pgvector, AGE) or self-hosted Milvus at production scale
* GitOps tooling (Argo CD, Flux, GitHub Actions, etc.): we use deploy scripts today and welcome a view on whether to change that


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits.
* Office in central Stockholm with a flexible hybrid environment.
* Career growth and development opportunities.


 How to Apply
   

  

 Send your resume and preferably a short cover letter detailing your relevant experience and what excites you about this role to careers@nooga.net.
   

  

 Senior Backend Platform Engineer
   

  

 It's Time to Apply!
   

  

 Email us

title: Arkivarie / handläggare till stadsarkivet
description:
**Välkommen till oss**
**Stadsarkivet** 
 är en central resurs i stadens informationsförsörjning och en av förutsättningarna för att offentlighetsprincipen ska fungera. Vi utvecklar ständigt våra arbetssätt för att öka tillgängligheten och värdet av våra tjänster, så att de fyller behoven hos moderna människor. Vi är med och skapar den transparenta staden – där information om då och nu blir byggstenar för morgondagen.
   

  

**På avdelningen tillgängliggöra arkivinformation** 
 är vi 25 medarbetare uppdelade på två enheter med varsin enhetschef. Vårt uppdrag är att ge god service till besökare och användare av stadsarkivets tjänster. En förutsättning för att vi effektivt ska kunna lämna ut handlingar är att arkiven är tydligt ordnade och förtecknade. I vårt arbete möter vi många människor med olika förväntningar vilket ställer krav på god service och lyhördhet.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en arkivarie / handläggare till den ena enheten.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Vi erbjuder dig
   

  

* ett arbete med engagerade kollegor
* arbetsplats i trivsamma lokaler på Kungsklippan på Kungsholmen och på Liljeholmskajen
* friskvårdsbidrag och en timme friskvård per vecka på arbetstid
* arbete under kontorstid med möjlighet till flex, torsdagar har vi öppet till klockan 19.00
* möjlighet till semesterväxling.


**Din roll**
 I rollen som arkivarie innebär dina arbetsuppgifter främst att
   

  

* lämna ut allmänna handlingar och handlägga ärenden som omfattas av sekretess enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen (OSL)
* arbeta i våra läsesalar och ge råd till besökare eller användare
* delta i övrigt arbete på enheten.


**Din kompetens och erfarenhet**
 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* högskoleutbildning, gärna inom arkivvetenskap, historia och/eller juridik
* aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta inom offentlig förvaltning
* arbetat med att lämna ut allmänna handlingar enligt tryckfrihetsförordningen
* god digital kompetens och lätt för att arbeta i nya digitala program
* vana att arbeta i Officepaketet och Outlook
* god förmåga att formulera dig muntligt och skriftligt på svenska.


 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  

* arbetat med att lämna ut allmänna handlingar och gjort sekretessbedömningar (så kallade menprövningar) enligt offentlighets- och sekretsslagen (OSL)
* arbetat i Platina (kallat eDok i staden) eller i annat dokument- och ärendehanteringssystem
* arbetat med e-arkiv, gärna iipax (kallat e-arkiv Stockholm i staden).


 För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara serviceinriktad och professionell. Du är flexibel och anpassar din inriktning när förutsättningar ändras. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha en helhetssyn och se till hela verksamhetens bästa. Du är självgående, lösningsorienterad och driver ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt. Vidare är du strukturerad. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet, engagemang och motivation för tjänsten.
   

  

 Vi är nyfikna på dig och ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Observera att på torsdagar har vi öppet till klockan 19.00 och arbetar utifrån ett rullande schema.
   

  

 Vi rekryterar utan personligt brev för att stärka fokus på kompetens och erfarenhet för denna roll. När du skickar in din ansökan får du svara på ett antal frågor. När vi bedömer din ansökan utgår vi från ditt CV och de frågor som du har besvarat. Efter sista ansökningsdag går vi igenom ansökningarna.
   

  

 Här kan du läsa mer om
   

  

* stadsarkivet
* våra förmåner
* hur det är att vara en del av Stockholms stad
* se en film om Stadsarkivet och vårt uppdrag


 Vi ser mångfald som berikande och välkomnar alla sökande.

title: Network-Focused Cloud Engineer
description:
**Do you find satisfaction in understanding how your technical expertise enables our business applications and by that be able to Power Climate Smarter Living?**
 We need to strengthen our cloud operations team with an additional colleague who is driven by technical challenges and the urge to always find better and more efficient ways of delivering services to the customer.
   

  

**The Digital Platform Operation Team is a multi-competence Team, operating the Vattenfall Digital Platform** 
 ; this comes with a big variety of tasks to ensure stable cloud systems. Those tasks are governance (ensuring architectural and security compliance), IaaS, PaaS, Network operation, Monitoring support, Azure DevOps support and capacity management. To handle all those different topics we must automate as much as possible and provide self-service functionality.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 As our
 **Cloud Engineer** 
 your major responsible for ensuring a stable cloud platform which is evolving with the needs of the organization.
   

  

**Specific Tasks Would Include**
* Cloud Networking
+ Understanding Cloud-onPrem connectivity (ExpressRoute, MPLS, BGP)
+ Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based network architectures (e.g., VPCs, subnets, routing, paas specific subnet creation, network Segmentation, private endpoints).
+ Collaborate with DevOps, security, and development teams to integrate networking solutions.
+ Automate network infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like PowerShell, Bicep / Arm.
+ Monitor and troubleshoot network performance issues in cloud environments.
+ Knowledge in designing and operating Next Gen Firewall Environments, ideally Check Point.

* Scripting
+ Writing scripts in Powershell, Bash

* Automation and orchestration
+ Creating and maintaining automation based on scripts using e.g. REST

* Configuration Management
+ Using tools like ARM templates, Bicep but also Ansible or DSC

* OS support
+ Troubleshooting OS issues with Windows and Linux

* Governance
+ Ensuring proper usage of tagging, permission handling, naming and policies
+ Support platform audits

* Financial analyses
+ Having a good understanding of the cloud financial model and the TCO
+ Giving advice on cloud consumption

* Security
+ Manage and react on alerts from Azure Security Center
+ Guiding projects together with IT security for secure implementation

* Source Code Management (Azure DevOps)
+ Manage Azure DevOps (create project rooms, licenses management, feature enablement)
+ Backlog handling


**Location**
 Stockholm, Amsterdam, Berlin or Katowice
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Your profile**
 In the role as
 **Cloud Engineer** 
 with the
 **focus on Network** 
 you will be working in a team that is very close to business but also to Agile IT and Core IT. To succeed in this role it is important that you have the ability to get an T-shaped skill profile. Whereas it is expected you are an expert on Network in Cloud environments. However do also have a basic understanding of OS, Backup, Security, Databases, Web, Azure Paas Services to still be the a generalist we are looking for. So there is not one person dealing e.g. with Network it is the whole team. Since automation is key for our delivery, you are also expected to have the ability to code and/or script. You need to be able to let go of traditional way of working and be open for a fast changing and developing environment.
   

  

 You are not only an expert technician but you also have social competence and understands the need of the business. You always challenge yourself and others how to improve and develop and are open for suggestions from others but can also give your own.
   

  

**As Cloud Engineer you dispose of the following qualifications and skills:**
* An academic Degree in IT, engineering, science or mathematics
* Interested in new technologies and a fast learner
* Experience with cloud services
* Experience in a large international environment
* Experience in troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Be able to work under pressure
* Ability to translate complicated technical matters into simple understandable language
* A broad and versatile profile with one or several areas of deeper technical knowledge


 We are looking for a specialist who is willing to develop to a
 **T-Shaped Cloud Specialist** 
 and has a background in network.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**Our offer**
 Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.
   

  

**More Information**
**We welcome your application in English, no later than, 27th of September 2026** 
 . We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than
 **via our website** 
 as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.
   

  

 For more information about the role, please contact the
 **Hiring Manager Daniël van der Vliet: daniel.van.der.vliet@vattenfall.com** 
 for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our
 **Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de)** 
 .
   

  

 At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.
   

  

 The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.
   

  

**We look forward to receiving your application!**
**Company Description**
 Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

title: Consumer Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?
   

  

 At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.
   

  

 Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
* Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
* Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
* Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
* Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
* Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
* Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


**Your profile**
 You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.
   

  

**Experience & Mindset**
* Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
* Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
* Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
* Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
* Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


**Analytical toolkit**
* Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
* Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
* Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
* Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
* AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
* Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
* Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


**What You'll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Senior Producer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Producer to join an exciting new project early in its development phases. You will get a chance to help build a multi-disciplinary team from the ground up, participate in hiring, establish how the team achieves success and then lead them towards those successes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Overseeing the development process, managing timelines, resources, scope, and quality
* You are responsible for end-to-end delivery, ensuring predictable project outcomes through effective tracking, risk mitigation, and problem-solving
* You understand pipelines, identify bottlenecks, and work systematically to improve efficiencies
* Assume accountability for overall team progress and timely delivery of milestones and other key deliverables.
* Ensure that needed ceremonies (such as stand-up, retros, progress reporting etc) are instituted and conducted.
* Be a champion for your team by removing blockers, optimizing the flow of communication, facilitating collaboration and nurturing a sense of shared ownership.
* Establish and continuously evolve workflows and pipelines.
* Participate in hiring for your team and facilitate relaxed but efficient onboarding experiences.
* Identify ways to leverage outsourcing opportunities where sensible
* Assume people management responsibilities for a group of developers, supporting them in their growth and career development. You are accountable for the entire employee journey of your direct reports, from hiring to onboarding, probation period evaluation, all the way to eventual offboarding


**Who You Are**
* At least 5 years experience as a Producer or Project Manager.
* Been involved with at least one game project through a complete development cycle.
* Has led a full or significant part of a multi-disciplinary development team.
* Thorough understanding of agile game development methodologies.
* Experience of common tools of trade such as JIRA, Confluence, Figma etc.
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Servant-leadership, team-first and collaborative mindset.


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: District Manager - Stockholm
description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE**
 JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more. When joining us, you step into a high-energy community where the music is loud, the bar is your stage, and your personality matters as much as your skills.
   

  

 We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:
   

  

* Positive Attitude
* Inclusion
* Social Ties
* Growth


 For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new — you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.
   

  

 From your first day, you’ll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing, move through a clear Moneyball career path, and be part of a company where most leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!).
   

  

 If you love fast-paced service, music, people, and the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that can take you across cities, countries, and roles.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a District Manager at JOE & THE JUICE, your district is yours to build. You spar closely with your Operational Manager, and you lead the Store Managers who lead every store beneath you, giving you a full financial and operational view across your whole district. Your success here comes down to how well you develop genuinely engaged leaders, so that every store under you delivers the guest experience that turns first-timers into regulars. You report to your Operational Manager, and you're ultimately accountable for your district's cost budget, sales targets, and profit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead your team the way JOE leads, grounded in our virtues, not just what's written in a handbook, and make sure every Store Manager under you leads that way too
* Own recruitment, onboarding, and performance management for your managers, working closely with HR, and always have your district's next generation of talent ready before you need them
* Develop your Store Managers through real 1-1 plans, engagement actions, and hands-on training, so leadership across your district keeps getting stronger, not just staying afloat
* Keep every store in your district safe, compliant, and up to standard, with full accountability for maintenance and facilities across the board
* Make sure shift planning works across every store, accounting for seasonality and local events, while keeping every team's hours fair, legal, and within budget
* Stay on top of stock and cost of goods sold across your district, so no store drifts past target
* Own the numbers for your whole district, sales, profit, and the KPIs that come with running more than one store at once, reviewed weekly and monthly, not just when something goes wrong


**Who You Are**
* You think in numbers as easily as you think in people, because at this level, both matter equally
* You communicate clearly, even across multiple stores and managers, and people trust what you tell them, because you mean it
* You're not here because a title is going to change your life, you're here because you never stop adding tools to your toolbox, and at this level, the tool you're building isn't a skill, it's other leaders
* You're genuinely motivated to grow as a people-centric leader at scale, someone who wants to build other leaders, not just manage a location


**What You'll Bring**
* Experience leading managers, not just a floor team, with a clear understanding of the difference between running a store and building people who can run one themselves
* Experience requirement needed, e.g. prior Store Manager experience, years in multi-unit leadership
* Punctuality and a sharp, professional appearance, respecting your team and your guests, and doubly so when setting the standard for every store in your district
* Schedule: Full-time


**About Joe & The Juice**
 JOE & THE JUICE is a healthy fast-casual concept founded in Copenhagen in 2002; since then, we have grown to more than 500 locations across 20 countries and now employ more than 4,500 people worldwide. From day one, our ambition has been to prove that there should be no trade-off between taste and health.
   

  

 We serve high-quality, freshly prepared juices, shakes, coffee, and sandwiches in relaxed, contemporary concept cafés that combine convenience with distinct urban atmospheres. JOE & THE JUICE goes beyond products towards the full experience around the bar, creating a consistent universe for guests and Juicers in all our locations.
   

  

 We invest heavily in internal development through our Moneyball career system and a culture where most leaders, including C-suite, VPs, and directors, have started behind the bar. We continue to evolve our people-centric and sustainability agenda that is part of our Nordic heritage and our commitment to a better future.

title: BDR Team Lead EMEA
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 We are seeking a high-impact
 **Business Development Team Lead** 
 to lead our EMEA sales organisation through its next phase of growth. You’ll be responsible for scaling a high-performing BDR organisation, coaching reps into world-class BDRs and driving consistent execution across the region.
   

  

 You’ll own pipeline generation, talent development, and scalable processes, while also representing as the top of funnel leader in Stockholm.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives, creating a culture of accountability, coaching and continuous improvement.
* Own outbound pipeline generation, ensuring the team consistently creates high-quality opportunities that contribute meaningfully to company growth.
* Define performance standards, monitor key metrics and use data to identify opportunities to improve conversion, productivity and execution.
* Coach BDRs through regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal inspections, helping them develop the skills and confidence to exceed their targets.
* Partner closely with Sales, Marketing and Operations to ensure campaigns, territories, messaging and processes maximise pipeline creation.
* Hire, onboard and develop exceptional talent, building a strong bench of future Account Executives and sales leaders.
* Continuously refine outbound strategies, testing new approaches, tooling and messaging to improve response rates and overall effectiveness.
* Foster a customer-first mindset, ensuring every interaction reflects the quality and professionalism of the Legora brand.


**What Will Help You Thrive**
* Experience leading and developing high-performing Business Development or SDR teams in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
* A track record of building repeatable outbound motions that consistently generate qualified pipeline.
* Strong coaching skills, with evidence of helping individuals improve performance and progress in their careers.
* A data-driven approach, using metrics to diagnose challenges, prioritise improvements and measure success.
* Excellent collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations.
* The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, knowing when to zoom in and when to step back.
* Strong communication skills and the credibility to influence stakeholders across the business.
* Ambition, resilience and a passion for building high-performing teams in a fast-growing environment.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Product Designer
description:
Are you an experienced Product Designer who enjoys solving complex problems together with experts from different fields? At RaySearch, you’ll help transform advanced clinical needs into thoughtful, impactful software used in cancer treatment worldwide
   

  

**About The Role**
 Designing for oncology software means working in a demanding but meaningful domain. You'll make confident, well-reasoned design decisions that uphold safety, accessibility, and risk management standards, working alongside clinical specialists, physicists, and developers advancing cancer care.
   

  

 As a Product Designer at RaySearch, you'll translate complex clinical needs into precise, user-centered interfaces designed with empathy. Working across product teams, you'll design role-specific workflows, evolve our design system, and ensure every detail holds up in the real world.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role focused on implementation, quality, and impact. You'll design flows and UI components, collaborate closely with developers, and validate your work through usability testing. You're expected to take initiative, follow through, and continuously improve the way we design, from Figma to code prototypes to the experience in the clinic.
   

  

 You'll join a UX team of designers and clinical specialists who design treatment systems used by clinicians worldwide, software that holds up when it matters most.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design detailed user flows and high-fidelity UIs for complex clinical systems.
* Create and refine components based on our design system, adapted to real workflows.
* Prototype and test concepts early, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and safe.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and clinicians to deliver production-ready solutions.
* Take ownership of your work and have the ability to balance multiple constraints in complex design decisions.


**Your profile**
**Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who can navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts across a wide range of disciplines. In this role, you will work closely with professionals from software engineering, medical physics, and clinical domains, bridging different perspectives to create user-centered solutions in a highly specialized environment. You are structured, proactive, and take ownership of initiatives, driving the design process forward while aligning user needs, technical possibilities, and business goals. Further, we would like you to have:
   

  

* A relevant academic background in Product Design, Interaction Design, UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* 5+ years designing complex products, with a portfolio of shipped work.
* Skilled in Figma and AI prototyping tools.
* Strong knowledge of building and maintaining design systems.
* Comfortable in regulated, complex environments, healthcare, medtech, or similar.
* It is meritorious if you have direct experience designing for oncology, radiology, or clinical decision support.


**Our Culture**
 Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems, no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.
   

  

**Our Offer**
 At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
   

  

**Application**
 Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

title: Processoperatör
description:
Är du en problemlösare med öga för detaljer som vill arbeta med den senaste tekniken i en högteknologisk miljö?
   

  

 Som processoperatör hos oss på Silex blir du en viktig del av ett världsledande svenskt företag inom MEMS-tillverkning. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en renrumsmiljö och bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens teknik.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om Silex och vad vi gör? Läs mer här.
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 I den här rollen kommer du att arbeta i hjärtat av Silex, vår produktion som kallas ”fabben”, där cirka 200 processoperatörer arbetar i femskift, dygnet runt, året om. Som processoperatör kommer du att vara delaktig i flera olika tillverkningssteg med varierande utrustning i renrumsmiljö.
   

  

 De fem olika skifttiderna är:
   

  

* Dag: måndag–torsdag 06:50–14:45, fredag 06:50–13:30
* Kväll: måndag–torsdag 14:30–23:15
* Natt: måndag–torsdag 23:00–07:00
* Helgskift dag: fredag 13:15–23:30, lördag–söndag 07:00–19:00
* Helgskift natt: fredag 23:15–07:00, lördag–söndag 18:45–07:00


 Just nu söker vi främst personer till dag-, kväll- och nattskiften.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter:**
 Arbetet utförs i renrum med renrumskläder (renrumsdräkt, skyddsglasögon, munskydd etc.). I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Processa skivor enligt givna instruktioner i Silex körjournal
* Utföra mikroskopavsyning efter färdigställd process
* Medverka vid och genomföra processkontroller av utrustning
* Arbeta med varierande uppgifter beroende på område – t.ex. SPC:er, maskinbearbetning, kvalitetstestning, mikroskopavsyningar, hantering av kemikalier och ugnar m.m.


**Vi söker dig som:**
* Har gymnasieexamen
* Talar flytande svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift
* Har erfarenhet från produktion, lager eller annat strukturerat arbete med tydliga rutiner och krav


**Som person är du:**
* Tekniskt intresserad och nyfiken på att lära dig och utvecklas inom en högteknologisk verksamhet
* Noggrann och har en stadig hand för precisionsarbete
* Strukturerad och har förmåga att planera och prioritera ditt arbete
* Lugn, med ett gott humör även i stressiga situationer
* En teamplayer med god samarbetsförmåga som prestigelöst fokuserar på gemensamma mål


**Vad vi erbjuder:**
* Ett nära samarbete med fantastiska kollegor
* Arbete med den allra senaste tekniken inom MEMS
* En plats på ett ledande företag som driver teknikutvecklingen framåt
* Stort kunskapsutbyte med världsledande experter inom MEMS-processintegration och -utveckling


**Om Silex:**
 Silex är världens största och mest avancerade renodlade MEMS-foundry med huvudkontor i Stockholm. MEMS finns i nästan all modern teknik – från personliga enheter och fordonselektronik till medicinsk utrustning och värmehanteringssystem.
   

  

 Med ett team av expertingenjörer, operatörer, tekniker, specialister och andra nyckelpersoner förverkligar Silex idéer och koncept från branschens ledande teknikbolag.
   

  

 Silex samlar några av de mest talangfulla, nyfikna, visionära och målinriktade personerna för att tillsammans med kunder bryta ny mark och utveckla den senaste MEMS-teknologin för globala tillämpningar. Hos oss arbetar du med världens största teknikföretag och innovationsledare inom medicin, life science, konsumentelektronik, telekommunikation, fordonsindustri och tillverkningsindustri.
   

  

**Övrig information:**
 Som en del i vårt arbete för en mer rättvis och fördomsfri rekryteringsprocess har vi valt att samarbeta med
 **Hubert.ai** 
 .
   

  

 Efter att du skickat in din ansökan kommer du att direkt bli inbjuden till en chattbaserad första intervju med vår virtuella rekryteringsassistent Hubert. Syftet med denna intervju är att göra urvalsprocessen snabbare och mer träffsäker – den ersätter inte den mänskliga intervjun, utan fungerar som ett första steg som hjälper oss att skapa bättre förutsättningar för ett mer djupgående samtal längre fram i processen.
   

  

 Intervjun tar normalt ca 10-15 minuter att genomföra och vi ser helst att du gör den så snart du har möjlighet. Om du vill ha tips inför intervjun kan du ta en titt på denna artikel:
   

  

 https://www.hubert.ai/insights/tips-och-rad-infor-din-forsta-hubert-intervju
   

  

 Rekryteringsprocessen är kompetensbaserad och kommer, tillsammans med den chattbaserade intervjun, inledas med personlighetstest och logiktest. Dessa tester kommer följas av ett samtal från rekryterare, gruppintervju och referenstagning. Vi genomför även bakgrundskontroll och drogtest innan anställning. Som arbetsgivare tillämpar vi även slumpmässiga alkohol- och drogtester under anställningen.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan – bli en del av vår spännande resa!**

title: Business Application Manager
description:
**About Legends Global**
 Legends global is redefining excellence in sport, entertainment and live events. With unrivalled expertise and international reach, we provide end-to-end solutions – from venue development and event programming to revenue strategy and hospitality.
   

  

 We take a 360-degree, data-driven approach across Partnerships, Hospitality, Merchandise and Attractions, working with leading clients to deliver outstanding experiences that resonate worldwide.
   

  

 Our organisation is committed to fostering an inclusive and forward-thinking environment where diversity drives innovation and collaboration. Guided by our values of Align, Scale, Connect, Team and Win... we create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

**Stockholm Live**
 Stockholm Live is a part of Legends Global, and is an arena operator managing some of the most visited venues in the Nordic region, including Avicii Arena, Strawberry Arena, 3Arena, Annexet, Hovet, and Södra Teatern, as well as the SkyView attraction at Avicii Arena. Each year, more than 3 million people visit the arenas to attend the events and activities hosted there.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Business Application Manager to take ownership of Stockholm Live's strategic business applications and drive their continued development. In this role, you will ensure that our business-critical platform including our mobile app, CRM, web platforms, payment solutions, ticketing systems, premium portals, and access control systems are reliable, integrated, and aligned with business needs.
   

  

 Working closely with teams across Marketing, Ticketing, Commercial, Operations, and IT, you will lead digital development initiatives, improve system integrations and automation, and enhance the experience for both visitors and internal users. You will also manage external technology partners, leverage data and insights to optimize digital performance, and help shape Stockholm Live's digital future.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and develop Stockholm Live's core application landscape, including mobile applications, CRM, web platforms, payment and access control systems
* Drive system integrations and digital development initiatives that improve business processes, automation and customer experience
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify business needs, implement new functionalities and support digital transformation initiatives
* Use data, analytics and customer insights to optimize digital performance through reporting, dashboards, Google Analytics, A/B testing, and AI-driven initiatives
* Train and support internal users, as well as managing vendor relationships, contracts and procurement processes for new technology solutions.


**Who are you?**
 To succeed in this role, you have broad technical expertise across mobile applications, CRM platforms, web systems, and system integrations. You are skilled at translating business needs into effective digital solutions and enjoy working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders.
   

  

 You are proactive, structured, and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and excellent communication skills. With a passion for digital innovation and continuous improvement, you thrive on delivering reliable, user-friendly solutions that enhance business performance and create exceptional customer experiences.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has**
* Academic degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* Several years of experience in managing business-critical applications and digital platforms
* Strong knowledge of mobile applications, CRM systems, CMS platforms, Google Analytics, A/B testing, system integrations and web-based solutions
* Experience in working with external vendors, procurement processes and system implementation projects
* Experience in developing digital roadmaps and driving continuous system improvements
* Strong analytical skills with experience working with user data, reporting and digital insights
* Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken


*Meritorious*
* Experience from live entertainment- or event industry
* Experience working with ticketing platforms, payment systems or access control solutions
* Ability to translate business requirements into wireframes and user interface concepts using Figma.


**Employment Details**
 This is a permanent position with a 6-month probationary period. Collective agreement with a monthly salary. Start date: Upon agreement. Location: Globe District.

title: Total Rewards Analyst
description:

 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 As Total Rewards Analyst, you'll be the analytical backbone of Legora's reward function — turning data into insight across compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility. You'll work directly within the Total Rewards team, reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, and collaborate closely with the Total Rewards Manager.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who is energised by making sense of complex data, building robust processes, and making sure every part of our reward engine runs smoothly and accurately.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and maintain reward reporting and dashboards covering compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — enabling the team and leadership to make data-informed decisions.
* Support compensation benchmarking cycles: gather and clean market data, model scenarios, and present findings clearly.
* Analyse equity data to track grant activity, vesting milestones, and programme performance across regions.
* Build and improve People operations processes across the reward function — creating workflows and documentation that reduce manual effort and increase accuracy.
* Support the administration of benefits programmes across markets, coordinating with external vendors and ensuring data accuracy.
* Support the mobility programme operationally — coordinating documentation, timelines, and third-party providers.
* Help prepare materials for employee and manager communications on compensation, benefits, and equity topics, and contribute to reward-related compliance activities as needed.


**Who You Are**
 You love digging into data to find patterns and build clarity out of complexity. You're a natural problem-solver with a keen eye for process, accuracy, and making things run better.
   

  

**We Think You'll Thrive Here If You Have**
* 3–5 years of experience in a People, Reward, Finance, or Operations analyst role — ideally in a high-growth or international environment.
* Strong analytical skills with experience handling complex datasets; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets is essential, and experience with HRIS or reward tools is a plus.
* Familiarity with compensation frameworks, equity programmes, or benefits administration — even if not a specialist in all areas.
* High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive, confidential data.
* A process-builder mindset: you don't just do the work, you look for ways to make the work better.
* Clear and confident communicator, able to present data and findings simply to a range of stakeholders.


**Why Legora**
 This is an exceptional opportunity to grow within a reward function that's building from the ground up. You'll gain broad exposure across every dimension of total rewards — compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — while working alongside experienced people leaders in a company with real momentum.
   

  

 We value clarity, humility, and impact. Your work will directly support the team that shapes how every Legora employee is rewarded. We're just getting started.
   

  

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Junior Utredare till ICA Försäkring
description:
Vill du ta nästa steg och växa in i en roll som utredare för att bidra till att göra skillnad i komplexa och oklara försäkringsfall. Är du analytisk, noggrann och trygg i kontakt med människor? Då kan rollen som junior utredare på ICA Försäkring på något av våra kontor i Stockholm, Borås eller Växjö vara nästa steg för dig.
   

  

**Om jobbet som Junior Utredare**
 I rollen som junior utredare innebär det att du succesivt utvecklas i ditt utredningsarbete. Du stöttar utredningsavdelningen och övriga kollegor i verksamheten i komplexa och oklara försäkringsfall. Du ansvarar för att samla in, analysera och värdera information för att skapa ett välgrundat beslutsunderlag.
   

  

 I rollen ingår kontakt med kunder, kollegor, samarbetspartners och andra relevanta aktörer. Du hanterar känsliga uppgifter och kan komma i kontakt med människor som befinner sig i utsatta eller svåra situationer. Ett professionellt och empatiskt bemötande är därför en viktig del av arbetet.
   

  

 Vi arbetar teamorienterat med stort fokus på kvalitet, noggrannhet och kundnytta. Samarbete, kunskapsdelning och snabb återkoppling är centrala delar av vår vardag.
   

  

**Är du den vi söker?**
 Vi söker dig som är redo att ta nästa steg och fördjupa sig i och granska och utreda oklara försäkringsfall. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet inom försäkring, polis eller annan myndighet där analys, informationsinhämtning och bedömning av komplexa ärenden varit en central del av arbetet.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har:
   

  

* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ex juridik, kriminologi
* Polisiär bakgrund
* Erfarenhet inom försäkringsbranschen och handlägga större komplexa skadeärenden.
* Erfarenhet att stötta och koordinera kollegor


 Vi fäster stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper som lyhördhet, medkänsla och engagemang.
   

  

 Du uttrycker dig mycket väl i både tal och skrift och har lätt för att strukturera information och presentera slutsatser på ett tydligt sätt.
   

  

**Därför ska du välja ICA**
 Varje dag är en härlig utmaning på ICA Försäkring. Varför det? Jo, för att hela vår bransch håller på att förändras. Och den förändringen öppnar för spännande utmaningar där gamla invanda sätt att jobba utmanas. Det betyder också att vi måste hålla oss i konstant utveckling. På riktigt. Både som individer och som verksamhet. Vi behöver föra samman innovation och digitalisering i en härlig kombination, där vi tillsammans kan hitta de där smarta och praktiska lösningarna som kunderna knappt vet om att de behöver.
   

  

 Läs mer om livet på ICA här.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Utredningschef Cissan Svensson via telefon 010-422 69 13 eller mejl cissan.svensson@ica.se. Tjänsten är på heltid och tillsvidare med placering på något av våra kontor i Stockholm, Borås eller Växjö. Tjänsten planeras att tillsättas tidigast from 2027-01-01 eller enligt ök.
   

  

 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag 2026-09-17
   

  

 ICA ska spegla våra kunder och samhället, vi strävar därför efter att anställa människor med olika bakgrund, kompetenser, kunskap och erfarenheter. Tester kan förekomma i processen. Vi värnar om goda arbetsmiljöförhållanden med mål och tillämpar drogtestning, kontroll av kreditupplysning och i vissa fall även utdrag ur belastningsregistret i samband med rekryteringen.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på ICA.

title: AI Engineer - Design Systems
description:
**Job Description**
**Your role**
 Are you looking to move into an AI-first team? Good! We’re shaping a new product team with a mission to overhaul how software is built and scaled.
   

  

 You will help create an enterprise-grade design system that connects design and code, enabling software to be built, edited, and shipped by describing intent in natural language. The goal isn’t only about enabling new ways of building software for human usage, but also creating software that will be used by AI agents.
   

  

 This position is for a high-agency, multidisciplinary engineer who thinks beyond linear workflows and established patterns. Someone who cares deeply about craft, but is equally motivated by experimentation, systems thinking, and inventing better ways of working. You will work closely with designers and engineers to explore how design, engineering, delivery, and AI should work together in practice inside a real enterprise environment.
   

  

 You will establish principles, architecture and processes that enable the product organization to become AI-first through using the new design system. A core part of the role is shaping how AI generates templates, screens, and flows by learning from design system components, markdown, templates, and user flows within our enterprise landscape.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Own the technical foundation of an AI-first, scalable enterprise design system.
* Translate design into code and continuously improve the system.
* Experiment with and establish AI-assisted workflows for design and engineering, using tools such as Figma Make, Vercel AI SDK, Replit, and Cursor.
* Shape how design system assets are created, versioned, and used when AI is part of the workflow.
* Reduce manual handoffs and repetitive work through better system structure, tooling, automation and by using ready-made assets from e.g. Tailwind.
* Build and maintain reusable frontend components with attention to accessibility, interaction, and consistency.
* Design workflows across MCPs, Storybook, Vercel AI SDK, and module federation.
* Support other engineers by making the design system clear, reliable, and easy to adopt.
* Document learnings, patterns, and guidelines.


**Your profile**
* Fundamentally excited about how AI can improve the way products are built.
* You’ve experimented with a bunch of AI tools in the past few years and have a desire to improve ways of working with the help of your learnings.
* Fluent in modern TypeScript, primarily React, GitHub synchronization, Tailwind, Storybook, and willing to dive into Figma MCP.
* Skilled at turning design intent into production-ready code and bringing static screens to life through interaction and motion.
* Experienced implementing design systems and translating Figma designs into production-ready code, adhering to accessibility-focused practices.
* Strong visual sensibility. You notice the difference when elements are off by a pixel or spacing is slightly off rhythm.
* Cares about typography, grids, responsive scales, and meaningful animation.
* Collaborative and detail-obsessed. You work well with designers and see code as a form of creative expression.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You’ve shipped real products and you care deeply about the user's experience.
* Familiar with Figma Tokens, Tokens Studio, or similar tools.


**Application**
 Do you feel this description matches your profile? We warmly welcome your application and look forward to reading it. Please note that including a link to your portfolio is essential for your application to be considered.
   

  

**What You'll Like About Working Here**
 We are shaping a new class of AI-first enterprise platforms and the design systems that support them. We believe in thoughtful craft, radical collaboration, and building with care. The person in this role will sit at the center of that, transforming design into something functional, elegant, and highly interactive.
   

  

 When you join Capgemini, you don’t just start a new job, you become something bigger.
   

  

 Capgemini’s purpose is to “unleash human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future”. Established in 1967 and now headquartered in Paris, we have become one of the largest technology consulting firms providing services to government, the environment, retail, health, manufacturing and aerospace. We live by our brand values: honesty, boldness, trust, freedom, fun, modesty and team spirit.
   

  

 Group IT delivers a comprehensive portfolio of technology services to the entire Capgemini Group. We look after more than 340,000 employees in countries and continents across the world, around the clock. We work with a wide variety of business lines, each requiring specific IT solutions and support. With people from a diverse range of cultures, all collaborating to achieve a common set of goals.
   

  

 The global User Experience team’s mission is to make IT simple. We do this by focussing on the end-user with the aim of making their lives easier and more productive through outstanding UX and automation. We run monthly UX meetups for the whole company and host an annual conference.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
