title: Senior Product Designer, iCasino
description:
**Job Description** 




*Veikkaus is a gaming company for everyone, striving to be better in every aspect. Our passion is to drive better gaming so that our customers can enjoy every moment. Caring, teamwork, and courage are the values that guide everything we do. Responsibility is a core of our operations. Our goal is to be a respected and successful international money gaming group that continuously improves while always putting both customers and employees first. For a better game — and working life.* 




  





**Senior Product Designer** 




*The future of gaming in Finland is changing – and we’re recruiting. In 2027, the Finnish license market will open, bringing a new era for iGaming. At Veikkaus, we’re preparing for this transformation - and we’re looking for passionate professionals to join us on this exciting journey.* 




*We’re strengthening our Betting and iCasino teams with true iGaming experts: people with international experience, a hunger for success, and a persistent drive to win. If you’re ready to help shape the future of responsible, competitive money gaming, now is the time to join us.* 




  





 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Product Designer – iCasino** 
 to work on end-to-end design for key features and create polished concepts, prototypes, design documentation, and high-fidelity UI across our digital Casino products. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with other product designers, researchers, product owners, and developers to deliver user-centered solutions that balance customer needs with business goals. Your work will shape how people experience our products, defining their look, feel, and usability while creating interactions that feel seamless, intuitive, and well-structured - ensuring quality, consistency, and excellence across every touchpoint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* End-to-end design for key features, from concept to delivery.
* Deliver high-quality user flows, concepts, prototypes, and design documentation.
* Facilitate design workshops and help shape design outcomes .
* Mentor junior designers and review work to ensure quality.
* Balance user needs with business goals in all design decisions.


- 


**Qualifications And Experience** 



* 5+ years of experience in product or UX design, with a track record of leading end-to-end design for consumer digital products.
* Experience shipping high-quality native mobile and web experiences, with a strong app-first mindset.
* Skilled in UX architecture, interaction design, UI design and scalable design systems.
* Ability to use customer insight, research and data to guide design decisions and improve outcomes.
* Clear communicator, able to explain design rationale, align stakeholders and integrate feedback effectively.
* Experience mentoring designers and contributing to a strong design culture.
* Proficiency in Figma, including libraries, as well as prototyping, collaboration practices and AI-supported workflows
* Experience designing for iOS, Android, and responsive web, with a solid understanding of platform conventions.
* Experience in the international iGaming industry is highly valued.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Design, HCI, or related field.



  





**We Offer** 



* A workplace where the game evolves – and so do you. You’ll face meaningful challenges and gain new skills while contributing to shared success – in Finland and beyond. We value curiosity and create the space for it to thrive.
* Inspiring and supportive teammates you can rely on. The best ideas and world-class entertainment are built together – and Veikkaus thrives because of its people.
* Balanced and inspiring work life. At Veikkaus, we believe a good job adds something to life – but isn’t all there is to it.
* Excellent employee benefits. You can read more about us and our benefits from here.



  





 It is important to us that everyone can come to work as their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, skills, and perspectives, and believe that success comes from working in diverse teams. We encourage individuals from various backgrounds to apply for our jobs.
 



  





 The position is located at Veikkaus’ headquarters in Pohjois-Haaga, Helsinki. We work in a flexible hybrid model, and we meet at the office three times a week. The role can also be performed remotely from Malta or Stockholm/Sweden. The position is permanent and full time.
 



  





**Interested?** 
 Awesome! Please send your application with your portfolio, CV and salary request no later than
 **26.08.2026.** 
 We are excited to hear from you!
 



  





 For any inquiries about the position don't hesitate to contact Sanna Shibasaki-Rosenberg, Head of Design at sanna.shibasaki-rosenberg@veikkaus.fi
 



  





*A drug test under Section 7 of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life (759/2004) will be conducted on the selected candidate.* 




  





**About Us** 




 Veikkaus on jokaisen suomalaisten oma peliyhtiö, joka kehittää vastuullista ja viihdyttävää rahapelaamista. Tarjoamme merkityksellisiä tehtäviä, kasvun mahdollisuuksia ja työyhteisön, jossa välittäminen, yhdessä tekeminen ja rohkeus näkyvät arjessa. Haluamme, että jokainen voi kehittyä, onnistua ja olla oma itsensä – samalla kun rakennamme menestystä yhdessä.
 



 Paremman pelin puolesta – ja työelämän.

title: SENIOR AI-FIRST UX DESIGNER
description:
**ABOUT PIHR** 




 Pihr is a European pay equity software company that helps employers analyse pay gaps, take action, and build sustainable pay governance. We are regulatory driven and are the European leader in helping companies become compliant with existing pay equity legislation and the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
 



  





 Founded in Sweden in 2012, Pihr combines advanced analytics with practical workflows that help HR teams move from insight to action. The platform is complemented by rewards advisory to support organisations in building fair and transparent pay structures.
 



  





 Today, more than 500 organisations use Pihr across multiple markets, analysing over 2 million salaries annually.
 



  





**ABOUT THE POSITION** 




 As our Senior AI-first UX Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the user experience of Pihr's pay equity platform - software trusted by HR professionals and executives in more than 50 countries to make fair, compliant pay decisions.
 



  





 We are building an AI-first product organization, and design is at the heart of it. You are a strong hands-on designer with a great visual eye and a high bar for quality. You are genuinely skilled at creating high-quality digital interfaces and turning complex problems into experiences that feel simple, trustworthy, and even enjoyable.
 



  





 You will work hands-on with modern AI-driven design tools to move from idea to high-fidelity, testable prototypes at a pace traditional design workflows can't match. You use AI as an important part of your design process to explore, create and iterate faster, and you stay curious about new tools and possibilities as they emerge.
 



  





 You will collaborate closely with product management and engineering in a lightweight, fast-moving process, translating complex regulatory requirements and data-heavy workflows into intuitive, well-crafted solutions.
 



 Your daily work will include discovery and user research with HR professionals across Europe, rapid AI-assisted prototyping and iteration, hands-on interaction and visual design, evolving our design system, and contributing to high UX quality throughout the product - from the first sketch to what ships.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS OF THE IDEAL CANDIDATE** 



* Strong design craft and visual eye – you are genuinely skilled at creating high-quality digital products and have a strong sense for layout, hierarchy, typography, interaction and visual detail.
* Strong UX and product thinking – you can turn complex user needs and problems into simple, intuitive experiences.
* Strong AI capabilities – you use AI confidently to explore, create, prototype and iterate faster while maintaining a high design standard.
* Curious and continuously learning – you keep up with new AI capabilities and evolve how you work as the technology develops.
* Minimum 3 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and high-quality design execution.
* Experience of designing for B2B SaaS software, ideally involving data-rich or compliance-driven products.
* Degree in User Interface Design or equivalent work experience.
* Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English – you can present, argue for, and document design decisions with clarity in both languages.
* Curious, pragmatic, and collaborative; you're both an individual contributor and a team player who thrives when working closely with engineers and product managers.



  





**WHAT PIHR HAS TO OFFER** 




 Pihr offers an inclusive work environment with a positive high-energy culture. We are purpose driven and want to improve the workplace for millions of people globally.
 


* Flexible working hours
* Equal and fair pay
* 5000 sek annually in health benefit ("friskvård")
* ITP private pension
* Collective Agreement



  





**DETAILS** 




 Start: November 2026 
 



 Employment type: Full time.
 



 Location: Our office in central Stockholm – in the office at least 3 days a week.
 



 Salary: By Agreement.
 



  





 Submit your application as soon as possible, selection is ongoing. We are looking forward to reviewing your application: https://pihr.teamtailor.com/jobs/8278309-senior-ai-first-ux-designer

title: Design Director
description:
**Are you passionate about creating exceptional user experiences while inspiring a talented creative team to thrive?**
 We are looking for a
 **Design Director** 
 who balances strategic design vision with empowering team management and a pragmatic, execution-focused mindset. We have a bold ambition to be the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. To get there, we need a leader who has successfully built and elevated design practices before—someone who knows what "great" looks like, both in the final user experience and in the best-in-class ways of working that get us there.
   

  

 You will play a fundamental role in translating our consumer-centric strategy and ambition into world-class design execution that drives real user, business, and brand impact.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As the Design Director at Instabee, your mission is to embed user-centricity into our cross-functional initiatives and workflows, implement insights-driven design practices, and lead and develop our team of product and brand designers. You will collaborate closely with colleagues and stakeholders in strategy, product, analytics, tech, and operations. Together with your peers in Consumer, you will establish consumer ambassadorship and center of excellence - ensuring the consumer experience is top-of-mind in everything we do.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Fall Into Three Key Pillars**
* Drive Design Strategy & Transformation
* Develop and continuously hone the design practices at Instabee to achieve our high consumer experience ambitions, desired brand position, user-centricity, efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Champion the end-to-end user perspective across all development phases, from discovery and design execution to post-launch optimization.
* Demonstrate the value of great design for our user experience and business goals, building trust, credibility and the strong internal relationships needed to give design a strong voice in company decisions.
* Ensure our design organization stays on the forefront of the craft: exploring and putting emerging methodologies and technologies into practice.
* Lead and Empower the Design Team
* Recruit, coach, develop, and lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of product and brand designers working with teams and stakeholders across the organization.
* Oversee brand and product design for Growth, Operations, Markets, and other key teams. Translate strategic business objectives and priorities into clear design strategy, adapting resources and capabilities to effectively support the organization and focus where it matters most.
* Champion high standards for design execution. Ensure design output is cohesive, high-quality, and clearly connected to user and business goals.
* Deliver Senior Design Excellence
* Keep one foot in the craft, driving own high-impact product and UX/UI design work - leading by example and showcasing best practices.
* Raise the bar for design and design processes across digital, physical and human interactions, ensuring we deliver "brilliant basics" enhanced by targeted signature “wow moments” that differentiate us.
* Act as a strong facilitator bringing cross-functional experts together to solve complex consumer challenges and drive user-centric innovation.


**Your Profile**
* 8+ years of experience in senior consumer-focused design or product UX/UI roles within a fast-paced service, product, or tech environment.
* A proven track record of design execution that drives clear user, business, and brand impact.
* Solid experience building, leading and elevating multidisciplinary design teams. Skilled at unlocking the potential of different individuals and design disciplines.
* A working-leader mindset, with a passion for keeping your own senior design craft sharp and a desire to lead by example.
* Strong change management capabilities, with a history of successfully integrating design best practices into cross-functional work and influencing without formal ownership.
* A systems-thinking approach, allowing you to see the full customer journey across touchpoints while seamlessly moving between high-level strategic alignment and hands-on operational details.
* Great communication, facilitation and leadership skills, enabling you to build trust, inspire teams, and confidently navigate complex cross-organizational environments as a strong voice for the consumer and the business value of design.


**What You’ll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

description:

 Immediate / As soon as possible

 Full-time

 We are looking for an experienced

title: Digital Designer
description:
This is a
 **one-year interim position,** 
 with the possibility of exploring future opportunities together beyond the initial term.
 



 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





*While we welcome applications from everywhere, please note that at this stage we are prioritizing candidates who are* 
***already based in Stockholm***
*and* 
***eligible to work in Sweden without visa sponsorship.***




 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**We are Bambuser, and we are reshaping commerce** 




  





 People no longer shop the way they used to. Consumers increasingly discover, evaluate, and buy products through video. They want to see products in action, hear real opinions, ask questions, and feel confident before purchasing.
 



  





 That's why some of the world's most iconic brands – including LVMH, Sephora, Sonos, Audi, Decathlon and Benefit Cosmetics, use Bambuser to bring video into their online shopping experiences.
 



  





 But building great products is only part of the equation.
 



 To earn attention, build trust, and tell compelling stories in a crowded market, every interaction with our brand matters.
 



  





*That's where you come in. ✨* 




  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**About the role**




 Design at Bambuser is about helping people understand.
 



 Whether you're creating a sales presentation, a landing page, an event experience, a customer story, or a campaign asset, your work will help shape how prospects, customers, partners, candidates, and investors perceive Bambuser.
 



 You'll work across Commercial, Marketing, Product and Leadership teams to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging, high-impact communication.
 



 Some days that might mean helping sales tell a stronger story.
 



 Other days it might mean improving a website experience, creating assets for a global event, or helping package a new product launch.
 



 We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding the problem behind the brief. Someone who asks questions, cares about outcomes as much as aesthetics, and sees design as a business tool, not just a creative discipline.
 



  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**What you'll do**



* Translate complex products, ideas and strategies into clear, compelling visual communication
* Design and build digital experiences including landing pages, web content and campaign assets
* Support commercial teams with presentations, customer stories and materials that help win business
* Create marketing assets across social media, paid campaigns, product launches and brand initiatives
* Bring Bambuser into the physical world through event experiences, print materials and branded environments
* Continuously improve how Bambuser shows up across every customer and candidate touchpoint
* Maintain and evolve a consistent, high-quality visual identity across channels
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to understand goals and shape effective solutions



 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**Who you are**



* We think you'll thrive here if you're naturally curious about why things need to be designed, not just how.
* You enjoy understanding business objectives, user needs and communication challenges before jumping into execution.
* You're comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on production, and you're energized by variety rather than confined by it.
* You have strong design fundamentals, high standards, and an ability to bring clarity to complexity.
* You know when to challenge a brief, when to move quickly, and when details matter.
* Most importantly, you care about the impact your work creates.



 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**We believe you should have**



* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design and communication skills
* Experience designing across both digital and physical touchpoints
* The ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, engaging experiences
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* A structured way of working with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Fluency in professional English, written and spoken



  





**Your toolkit**




 Experience with the following is valuable:
 


* Figma
* Webflow
* Adobe Creative Suite
* Google Slides
* Motion design experience
* Video editing experience
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate creative workflows
* Experience working in SaaS, technology, e-commerce or high-growth environments



  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**Why Bambuser?** 




 We're operating at the intersection of some of the biggest shifts happening in commerce today: video, creators, social shopping and AI.
 



 The opportunity ahead is enormous.
 



 You'll join a company where your work will be visible, valued, and directly connected to business outcomes. You'll have the freedom to experiment, ownership to drive initiatives forward, and the chance to help shape how one of the leading companies in video commerce shows up to the world.
 



 If that sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





 This is a
 **one-year interim position,**

title: Design Engineer
description:
You know that bit where every company says they’re
 *“changing the world”* 
 ? Yeah, it can feel a little forced. But we like to think our story actually has some realness to it.
 



  





 Our story begins with
 **Shadi Bitar** 
 and
 **Ninos Malki** 
 , who came to Sweden from Syria as kids and discovered that books could be a bridge - helping them learn the language, understand the culture, and explore new worlds.
 



  





 A thought emerged,
 *what if everyone could have that?* 
 And just like that, Nextory was born - your all-access pass to read, listen, and discover new perspectives without limits. And now, we're on a quest to find a
 **Design Engineer.** 




  





**Let us tell you about the role 📖** 




 As a Design Engineer at Nextory, you’ll be working at the intersection of design and engineering, you’ll help turn ideas into fast, intuitive, and genuinely enjoyable experiences. Together with our six product designers, product managers, and engineers, you’ll take ideas from rough concepts to polished features in production.
 



  





 Frontend development is your craft, and you care deeply about building high-quality user interfaces with thoughtful interactions, great performance, and attention to detail. You’ll have ownership throughout the entire journey, from the first sketch to the final release, caring just as much about the technical implementation as the user experience.
 



  





**Your story so far 👀** 




 You thrive at the intersection of design and code. You move fast without losing your eye for detail, and you're equally energized by building tools other people use and great experiences for the users.
 



  





 We also believe that you have:
 


* Strong fundamentals in modern frontend development - Vue, React or similar architecture
* Experience building and extending design systems and component libraries in code, including working with Figma's developer tooling (Code Connect, Dev Mode, variables, component properties) to keep design and code in sync.
* A track record of building internal tools, prototypes, and design-to-code infrastructure used by people across Nextory
* Skillset to take promising prototypes from rough exploration to polished, production-quality features, owning both the technical implementation and the end result.
* Good judgment on when to build for speed (a throwaway prototype) versus when to build for scale (a reusable component)



 A bonus if you also have experience and a keen interest in motion design.
 



  





**The Nextory way of working 🏠** 




 At Nextory, we believe a strong and inclusive culture is key to our success and that culture flourishes when we meet and collaborate in person as much as possible. That’s why we spend the majority of the working time at our beautiful office!
 



  





 We are based in Stockholm, Sweden, with offices in Paris and Bangalore. Our hybrid work policy includes four days in the office and Wednesdays as a work-from-home day.
 



  





**Your next story starts here 💫** 




 We look forward to your application 💫. Applications are reviewed continuously, if you have any questions about the role, please contact
 
 erika.thorslund@nextory.com
 
 .
 



  





*Please note that we do not offer relocation and that a six-month probationary period applies.*

title: Design Director (visual/digital)
description:
Above is looking for a Design Director to join our creative team based in our Stockholm studio. This is a permanent full-time role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Visual Design Director you will be a key player in driving cutting-edge design and innovation projects for some of the world’s most exciting brands. You will help us identify and secure new commercial opportunities, acting as a strategic partner for new and existing clients.
   

  

 With a high level of conceptual thinking, you will have a direct impact in shaping excellent project deliveries through craft and creativity, while also shaping our culture, team capabilities, and ways of working across disciplines.
   

  

 Our work is exciting and diverse in nature, spanning digital experiences such as websites, apps, and HMI. We collaborate across disciplines to create impact across all organizational levels and future horizons — from category-defining hero products to multidimensional digital ecosystems.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for an inspiring, forward-thinking Design Director who demonstrates excellence in craft, creativity, leadership, and emerging technologies:
   

  

* Forward-thinking approach to digital product experiences, with a keen interest in emerging trends and future developments
* Holistic thinker with strong conceptualization skills and critical-thinking abilities, comfortable leading conversations with stakeholders across design, technology, and business
* Demonstrated commercial experience in selling impactful digital experience projects — ideally supported by a strong professional network
* Strong storytelling and client leadership, with the ability to clearly communicate ideas and thought processes to both peers and clients
* Preferably 10+ years of professional experience, including familiarity with fast-paced agency environments and workflows
* Ability to lead, mentor, and grow multidisciplinary design teams, fostering creative excellence, psychological safety, and high performance
* Ability to lead clients through complex challenges and structure design processes that enable diverse teams to succeed
* Aesthetic sensibility in harmony with a thoughtful, user-centered approach to design, business, and technology
* Experience using — or actively driving — AI-enabled design workflows to explore ideas faster, prototype more intelligently, and elevate creative and strategic outcomes
* Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into meaningful design direction, team practices, and client value
* A humble, self-propelled, and collaborative team player who feels at home in multi-competence project constellations


**A Bit About Above**
 We are a Scandinavian innovation agency dedicated to driving positive change through the integration of design, strategy, and technology. Our creative 360-approach allows us to break down boundaries between the physical and digital, while fusing hardware and software into meaningful experiences.
   

  

 We work with leading global brands, local Scandinavian heroes, and a fantastic collection of startups. We’re a team of warm, welcoming, dedicated professionals with diverse international backgrounds. In everything we do, we strive for world-class results and believe you share that mindset.
   

  

 Join a team that values collaboration, creativity, and tangible impact through thoughtful design.
   

  

**Join our team**
 Please submit your portfolio, CV, and personal letter.
   

  

 We welcome international applications and are generally able to assist with work permits and relocation.

title: Vikarierande systemadministratör
description:
Höglandsförbundet – Samverkan är vår styrka!
  
Höglandsförbundet är ett kommunalförbund bildat av Aneby, Eksjö, Nässjö, Sävsjö och Vetlanda. Dessa fem kommuner, på småländska höglandet, värdesätter samarbete och vet att vi blir starkare tillsammans. Genom att slå ihop våra styrkor och resurser kan vi öka kompetensen, bättre utnyttja resurser, höja kvaliteten och ge invånarna bättre service. Hos oss finns idag en rad olika verksamheter som arbetar för hela Höglandets bästa.
  
  

1 plats(er).
  
  

Är du en noggrann person som gillar att lösa problem och bidra till effektiva arbetssätt? Är du dessutom lösningsorienterad och gillar att arbeta i nära samverkan med både verksamhet och systemförvaltning? Då har vi tjänsten för dig!
  
Ditt nya jobb
  
Vi söker en systemadministratör till Höglandets verksamhetsstöd. Som systemadministratör ansvarar du för att ge verksamheten ett professionellt och serviceinriktat stöd genom att arbeta i första linjens support. Du arbetar nära användare och systemförvaltare för att säkerställa att systemen används på ett säkert, effektivt och ändamålsenligt sätt. Genom ett strukturerat arbetssätt bidrar du till hög kvalitet i systemens information och till att verksamhetens behov möts på bästa sätt.
  
I rollen arbetar du i samtliga system som förvaltas av Höglandets verksamhetsstöd. Du tar emot, felsöker och löser enklare supportärenden samt ger användarstöd och vägledning i systemen. Du hanterar bland annat behörighetsbeställningar enligt fastställda rutiner, registrerar och administrerar resurser samt uppdaterar och kvalitetssäkrar information i systemen. Arbetet omfattar även manuell registrering av uppgifter från exempelvis listor, Excel-filer och andra underlag. Du kommer även vara ett stöd till våra avgiftshandläggare i deras arbete med fakturering av vård -och omsorgsavgifter till invånarna i Aneby, Eksjö och Nässjö kommun.
  
När ärenden kräver ytterligare hantering skickar du dem vidare till systemförvaltare eller avgiftshandläggare. Du bidrar också aktivt till att utveckla och förbättra rutiner och arbetssätt utifrån inkommande ärenden och verksamhetens behov. En viktig del av ditt uppdrag är att säkerställa att arbetet utförs enligt gällande riktlinjer, processer och dokumentation samt att kvaliteten på manuellt inmatad data håller en hög standard.
  
Om dig
  
Vi söker dig som har minst gymnasieutbildning inom vård och omsorg, administration, IT eller ekonomi, alternativt har motsvarande erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har god IT-vana och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta i olika system och digitala verktyg.
  
För rollen krävs att du har grundläggande kunskap om socialtjänstlagen samt att du kan uttrycka dig väl på svenska i både tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i verksamhetssystem och om du tidigare har arbetat med administrativa uppgifter eller support.
  
Som person söker vi dig som är serviceinriktad och har ett genuint intresse för att hjälpa andra. Du bemöter användare på ett professionellt, lugnt och tillmötesgående sätt och strävar alltid efter att hitta lösningar som möter verksamhetens behov. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att arbeta nära både användare, kollegor och systemförvaltare.
  
Rollen kräver att du är strukturerad. Du planerar, organiserar och prioriterar ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt samtidigt som du säkerställer att information och data håller hög kvalitet. Du är självgående och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, samtidigt som du vet när du behöver involvera andra för att nå bästa resultat.
  
Vi söker dig som är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar. Du ser möjligheter i förändringar och kan snabbt ställa om när verksamhetens behov eller prioriteringar ändras.
  
Eftersom du kommer att hantera olika typer av supportärenden och administrativa uppgifter är det viktigt att du har en god problemlösande förmåga. Du kan analysera situationer, identifiera orsaker till problem och arbeta metodiskt för att hitta lämpliga lösningar. Du har också en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagare och situation och känner dig trygg i kontakten med användare på olika nivåer i organisationen.
  
Om oss
  
Höglandets Systemförvaltning är medlemsorganisationernas gemensamma funktion för förvaltning, utveckling och samordning av gemensamma system. Uppdraget är att genom samverkan, likriktning och helhetssyn säkerställa ett rättssäkert, ändamålsenligt och effektivt systemstöd till verksamheter i våra fem medlemskommuner, Aneby, Eksjö, Nässjö, Sävsjö och Vetlanda. Enheten finns i centrala Nässjö tillsammans med Höglandsförbundets systemförvaltare. Inom avdelningen finns även Höglandets ekonomiservice som du som systemadministratör också har ett nära samarbete med.
  
Bra att veta
  
Denna tjänst är ett vikariat med eventuell möjlighet till förlängning. Tjänsten utgår i från Nässjö och när du är varm i kläderna och trygg i arbetet finns möjlighet finns att arbeta på distans viss del av tiden.
  
Om du blir kallad till intervju behöver du kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap. Detta gör du genom att visa upp ett giltigt pass eller ett personbevis tillsammans med en giltig ID-handling. Personbevis beställs från skatteverket under mina sidor. Om du är medborgare i ett land utanför EU/EES/Schweiz ska du även kunna uppvisa giltigt uppehålls- och/eller arbetstillstånd för att arbeta i Sverige. Anställning kan ske först efter att arbetstillståndet har kontrollerats, i enlighet med utlänningsförordningen.
  
Vill du veta mer?
  
Välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Jenny Skiöld. Vill du kontakta facklig representant kontaktar du Margareta Stark, Vision.
  
Välkommen med din ansökan!
  
Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.
  
**Löneform:** Månadslön.
  
**Anställningsform:** Tidsbegränsad anställning.
  
**Varaktighet:** 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2027-03-31 .

title: Systemspecialist mobilhantering
description:
Gillar du managera mobila plattformar och kommunikationsnära system? Hos oss blir du en del av ett självgående team som jobbar med både standard- och egenutvecklade tjänster.


Här får du en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, bland annat genom vårt förmånliga hybrida arbetssätt.

### **Om jobbet**


Rollen ingår i ett tekniskt specialistteam med ansvar för myndighetens mobila plattformar och kommunikationsnära system. Arbetet omfattar drift, förvaltning, vidareutveckling och felsökning inom bland annat MDM-lösningar, mobilitet, klientnära infrastruktur. De system vi hanterar i dagsläget är primärt on-prem.


Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med andra tekniska specialister inom exempelvis Linux, Kubernetes och klientplattformar. Rollen innebär både operativt arbete och deltagande i kontinuerlig utveckling av arbetssätt, tekniska lösningar och automatisering.


Målet för rollen är att bidra till stabila, säkra och användarvänliga tekniska tjänster samt att aktivt bidra till teamets gemensamma kompetensutveckling och kunskapsdelning. Vi är ett jämställt team som ansvarar för ytor och applikationer som är byggda på plattformen. Fokus ligger på att modernisera och leverera förenklade lösningar för våra användare.

### **Din profil**


Vi söker dig som trivs med att samarbeta och som bidrar till ett positivt och inkluderande teamklimat genom att dela med dig av kunskap och erfarenheter. Du har ett serviceinriktat och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt, med en naturlig vilja att stötta både kollegor och verksamheten i det dagliga arbetet.


För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade behov, nya tekniker och arbetssätt. Du tar gärna initiativ, driver ditt arbete framåt på ett självständigt sätt och ser möjligheter till förbättring och utveckling. Vidare har du en god problemlösande analysförmåga och kan på ett metodiskt sätt analysera tekniska problem, felsöka och hitta långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

  

Vi söker dig som har:

* Utbildning inom IT, Systemvetenskap, Datateknik eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
* Grundläggande kunskaper inom IT-infrastruktur, systemförvaltning, nätverk, klientbaserade plattformar, mobila operativsystem iOS, certifikathantering inom nätverk, Exchange och containerbaserade miljöer.
* Dokumenterad kunskap i operativsystemet Windows
* Grundläggande Linux kunskap med önskan att växa inom detta område.
* Kunskap om hantering av mobiler via MDM/UEM (Mobile Device Management/Unified Endpoint Management) plattformar.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta strukturerat med felsökning och teknisk problemlösning.
* Förstå och kunna skriva script för automatisering, tex Python, Bash eller PowerShell.
* God förmåga att uttrycka sig i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* God förmåga att läsa och förstå teknisk dokumentation på engelska och svenska.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

* Erfarenhet av mobilhanteringssystem.
* Erfarenhet av e-postsystem.
* Erfarenhet av telefoni-/kommunikationsplattformar.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i säkerhetsklassad miljö.


Vi är öppna för kandidater med olika lång erfarenhet. För rätt person är vilja och förmåga att lära sig nytt lika viktigt som tidigare specialistkunskap. Rollen passar därför även dig som är tidigt i karriären men har ett starkt teknikintresse och driv att utvecklas inom området.

### **Vi erbjuder**


Ett myndighetsuppdrag som är viktigt på riktigt! En arbetsplats där vi värnar om att våra medarbetare ska ha en god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Vi erbjuder flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet att jobba delvis hemifrån. Som statligt anställd har du även goda anställningsvillkor och ett förmånspaket med friskvård, lediga klämdagar samt goda semester- och pensionsvillkor. Vårt kontor i Stockholm ligger centralt i Hornstull nära tunnelbanan.


Du kan läsa mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba hos oss här.

### **Bra att veta**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning.


Anställningen kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass.

### **Din ansökan**


Vi jobbar kompetensbaserat i hela processen och är måna om en inkluderande, rättvis, objektiv och kandidatvänlig process. Därför ber vi dig att besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor istället för att be om personligt brev.


Vi kan komma att använda oss av arbetspsykologiska tester.


Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontakta rekryterande chef som hjälper dig med din ansökan.


Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.


Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till annonskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför ytterligare kontakt med media-/annonsförsäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.


Pensionsmyndigheten ansvarar för den allmänna pensionen och informerar om hela pensionen. Varje år betalar vi ut cirka 415 miljarder kronor till 2,3 miljoner pensionärer, genomför cirka 911 000 fondbyten och skickar ut 8 miljoner orange kuvert. Vi har ca 25 miljoner digitala kundkontakter per år. Vi är cirka 1700 medarbetare på åtta orter, från Luleå i norr till Halmstad i söder.


Vi gör pensionen enklare.

title: IT Consultant, Netcompany Consulting (Swedish speaking)
description:
Company Description Job Description At Netcompany, we are looking for both newly graduated candidates with a relevant master's degree - or equivalent experience - who want to work as IT Consultants at the intersection of technology, business, and people. Do you want to help develop some of Denmark's most complex and business-critical IT solutions, where software development, project management, and close client collaboration are central parts of everyday work? Responsibilities and technologies As an IT Consultant, you help translate client needs into the right technical solution. We choose the technologies that best fit each project and client. As a result, you should enjoy working across a variety of technologies and domains, while continuously expanding your knowledge and expertise. A large part of our projects is based on web technologies such as Angular or React, and Java or C# on either a Java or .NET platform. In addition, we work with a wide range of standard platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and others. As an IT Consultant, you contribute to all parts of system development with a focus on technical tasks. Your responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilites will typically include: Setting up and developing frameworks and integrations.
  
Implementing features in user interfaces.
  
Configuring and developing extensions for standard platforms.
  
Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs.
  
Developing tools and scripts for migrating large volumes of data.
  
You will join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise. What we all have in common is a technical mindset and shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together. Our projects include some of Denmark's most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you will help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society. About you We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you: Are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience - most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.
  
Possess strong technical skills in object-oriented programming.
  
Have a solid understanding of software development and motivated to further develop your skills.
  
Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.
  
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.
  
Continue developing with us At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development. When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience. Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us. Join an inclusive community At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring. As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being. As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career. Send us your application Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

title: IT projektldeare - Svenska Kraftnät
description:
Senior IT-projektledare – Svenska kraftnät
  
Vi söker en senior IT-projektledare för ett långsiktigt och samhällsviktigt uppdrag hos Svenska kraftnät. Rollen är placerad inom området Balansering och Elmarknadslösningar och passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av att leda komplexa IT-projekt med många beroenden, intressenter och specialistkompetenser.
  
Det europeiska kraftsystemet och elmarknaden genomgår stora förändringar till följd av nya regelverk, ökad marknadsintegration och en allt mer digitaliserad energimarknad. I rollen får du möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av IT-lösningar som är centrala för Sveriges framtida kraftsystem.
  
Om uppdraget
  
Som IT-projektledare ansvarar du för att strukturera, planera och driva projekt från start till leverans. Du har ett helhetsansvar för projektets tidplan, budget, resurser, risker och resultat och rapporterar löpande till projektägare och styrgrupp.
  
Projekten kan omfatta både egenutvecklade IT-lösningar och införande av standardsystem. Du arbetar tillsammans med bland annat verksamhetsspecialister, utvecklingsteam, lösningsarkitekter, kravanalytiker, testledare och andra projektledare.
  
Arbetet bedrivs enligt etablerade styr- och projektmodeller, framför allt PPS, och rollen passar dig som är van vid klassisk IT-projektledning i större organisationer och komplexa verksamhetsmiljöer.
  
Arbetsuppgifter
  
  

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**  

Ha helhetsansvar för projektets tidplan, budget, resursallokering och resultat.
  
  

Leda, motivera och koordinera projektmedlemmar och andra involverade resurser.
  
  

Planera, strukturera och följa upp projektets aktiviteter och leveranser.
  
  

Säkerställa teknisk framdrift och att projektets mål uppnås.
  
  

Säkerställa att verksamhetens behov fångas upp och omsätts till fungerande IT-lösningar.
  
  

Samarbeta nära kravanalytiker, verksamhetsspecialister, lösningsarkitekter, testledare och utvecklingsteam.
  
  

Hantera beroenden och koordinera interna och externa intressenter.
  
  

Identifiera, följa upp och hantera risker.
  
  

Rapportera projektets status, progress, risker och avvikelser till projektägare och styrgrupp.
  
  

Planera och genomföra förankring av förändringar i organisationen.
  
  

Initiera processkartläggning i samband med förändring och utveckling av verksamhetsprocesser.
  
  

Vid behov leda förstudier, analyser och strategiska utredningar.
  
  

Säkerställa en strukturerad överlämning från projekt till förvaltningsorganisation.
  
  

Uppdraget kan även innehålla arbete kopplat till upphandling, verksamhetsarkitektur och uppdragsledning inom förvaltning.
  
Vi söker dig som
  
Du är en mycket erfaren IT-projektledare som är trygg i att självständigt driva komplexa projekt med många intressenter och beroenden. Du är strukturerad och kommunikativ och har förmågan att skapa framdrift även i stora organisationer där verksamhet, IT och externa parter behöver arbeta tillsammans.
  
  

**Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:**  

Senior IT-projektledning i större och komplexa organisationer.
  
  

Projektstyrning enligt etablerade modeller såsom PPS och/eller PM3.
  
  

Styrning av projekt avseende tid, kostnad, resurser, risk och resultat.
  
  

Ledning av tvärfunktionella projektteam.
  
  

Rapportering och kommunikation med projektägare och styrgrupper.
  
  

Projekt med många tekniska och organisatoriska beroenden.
  
  

Samarbete mellan verksamhet och IT.
  
  

Införande eller utveckling av större IT-system.
  
  

Förändringsarbete och överlämning till förvaltning.
  
  

Erfarenhet från energi, elmarknad, samhällskritisk verksamhet, offentlig sektor, upphandling eller verksamhetsarkitektur är meriterande.
  
Vi erbjuder
  
För dig som väljer en anställning hos oss erbjuder vi bland annat:
  
  

32 dagars semester
  
  

Full tjänstepension
  
  

Friskvårdsbidrag
  
  

Kompetensutveckling
  
  

Ett stöttande team
  
  

Vi är även öppna för frilansare och underkonsulter och diskuterar gärna ett upplägg som passar båda parter.
  
Ansökan
  
Är du en erfaren IT-projektledare som trivs med komplexa projekt och vill arbeta med IT-lösningar som har stor betydelse för det svenska kraftsystemet? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

title: IT Support Specialist (Level 1) | Automotive Solutions | Swedish Market

We offer complex, technology-driven solutions and services in the field of Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), making us unique within the Bosch world. In short, we take over operations from other companies and manage them on their behalf, allowing them to focus on their core business. At Bosch Service Solutions, our primary objective is to guarantee the best solutions and services to our clients, something we achieve in more than 30 languages worldwide. This is why we are a leading provider of process outsourcing, always leveraging technology as a foundation. At Bosch, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where every individual is valued and respected. Job Description Are you passionate about technology and do you enjoy resolving technical incidents? If you have experience in technical support, enjoy analyzing problems, working with ticketing tools, and helping find solutions, this opportunity might be for you. At Bosch Service Solutions, our main objective is to guarantee the best solutions and services to our customers, something we do in more than 30 languages around the world; that is why we are a leading provider of process outsourcing, always using technology as a base. Furthermore, at Bosch we are committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment, where all people are valued and respected. Problem-solving orientation.

Other European languages.

Full-Time Position.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The role We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our long-term partnership with ICA Banken. This is a full-time position based in Sarajevo, with remote work possible and occasional visits to the Sarajevo office. The planned start date is September 2026. We are looking for senior engineers, but strong Medior candidates with solid DBT experience are also encouraged to apply. Project You will work on designing and implementing a cloud-based data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The platform focuses on onboarding data through file-based, API-based, and event-driven pipelines, while creating reusable, domain-oriented analytical data products aligned with Data Mesh principles. You will collaborate closely with platform, analytics, and business teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and well-governed data solutions that support data-driven decision making across the organization. The work includes Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data ingestion pipelines
  
Building analytical data products using DBT
  
Developing analytical data models for reporting and analytics
  
Implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitHub
  
Working with file-based, API-based, and Kafka-based ingestion patterns
  
Ensuring data quality, reliability, and maintainability through testing and monitoring
  
Collaborating with platform and domain teams to onboard new data sources and evolve existing data products
  
**Requirements:** Minimum 5 years of professional data engineering experience
  
Strong hands-on experience with DBT (must-have)
  
Proven experience with file-based, API-based, and event-driven (Kafka) data ingestion
  
Experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines
  
Strong understanding of analytical data modelling techniques (dimensional, denormalized, and domain-oriented models)
  
Experience implementing CI/CD using GitHub and GitHub Actions
  
Good understanding of Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer
  
Practical understanding of Data Mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products
  
Experience with Python and Java
  
Experience working in Agile teams using Jira
  
Fluent English communication skills
  
**Additional notes:** Looker and/or Tableau
  
Experience working with cloud-native, product-oriented data platforms
  
Confluence
  
**Conditions ICA made it clear from day one:** this isn't a customer-supplier relationship. We operate as one team, one culture, side by side. Focus & stability Long-term partnership - Your growth is tied to the collaboration's success.
  
Single client focus - No context-switching. Go deep, build expertise, see impact over time.
  
Remote-friendly - Work remotely with occasional visits to our Sarajevo office.
  
Growth & learning Knowledge transfer - Learn directly from ICA's engineering teams in Sweden.
  
Access to ICA's learning hub - Internal training platform with mandatory and optional courses.
  
Travel to Sweden - Onboarding trips and ongoing workshops with Swedish colleagues.
  
Work-life balance & time off Five weeks off - 26 days of paid vacation. Swedish standard.
  
Flexible hours - Working hours and lunch breaks are flexible within the same time frame.
  
Religious & personal flexibility - 5 additional days for religious and personal observances.
  
Health & well-being Private health insurance - Comprehensive private coverage.
  
This is a dedicated long-term partnership with its own structure and benefits. These conditions apply to this opportunity and may differ from standard Zendev benefits. How does the hiring process look? Initial contact - You'll receive full details upfront. No surprises.
  
Pre-screening - Short conversation about your background.
  
Technical task - If applicable, clear instructions and fair deadlines.
  
Interview with ICA - Meet the Swedish team directly.
  
Check & offer - Background verification, then a clear offer.
  
Onboarding - Local setup + travel to Sweden for team integration.
  
About ICA ICA is Sweden's largest retailer, headquartered in Solna, Stockholm. The company operates grocery stores, ICA Bank, ICA Insurance, Apotek Hjärtat pharmacies, and a nationwide logistics network. ICA has been part of Swedish daily life for over a century. About Zendev Zendev is a Swedish-Bosnian software company. We provide engineering services to clients across Europe, with a focus on Scandinavia. We're built on long-term partnerships, not transactional relationships. If this sounds like something you'd enjoy, we'd like to hear from you. Our engineers already work daily with ICA's teams in Sweden. We understand the questions you might have: What's it like working with a Nordic partner?
  
How does collaboration between Sarajevo and Sweden actually work?
  
What should I expect in my first months?
  
That's exactly why we're here. Whether you're curious about the technical side or want to see if this fits your goals, let's talk. No pressure, just an honest conversation about what this role could mean for you. Apply now or reach out @ info@zendev.se with any questions.

title: Systemförvaltare Cosmic
description:
Vill du arbeta med IT som gör verklig skillnad? Som systemförvaltare hos oss är du med och utvecklar de digitala verktyg som vården använder varje dag.


I rollen arbetar du med att förbättra vårdsystemet Cosmic utifrån vårdverksamhetens behov och teknikens möjligheter. Genom din förståelse för vårdens arbetssätt bidrar du till lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för både vårdpersonal och patienter.


Du arbetar med flera system där Cosmic är det största. Arbetet sker i mindre arbetsgrupper med fokus på exempelvis vårddokumentation, behörigheter, läkemedel, utskrifter samt beställningar och svar. En viktig del av rollen är att säkerställa att systemen fungerar och att stötta användare genom att vara andra linjens support.


Du deltar även i utvecklingsprojekt och samverkar med vårdverksamheten och externa leverantörer. Verksamhetens behov och användarnas dagliga arbete i systemen är alltid i fokus. Tjänsten omfattar hela länet och din placering är i Kalmar, Oskarshamn eller Västervik.

Vi söker dig som har arbetat med vårdsystem och digital utveckling inom vården. Du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis hälso- och sjukvård, systemvetenskap eller annan relevant utbildning som bedöms likvärdig. Vi ser gärna att du har deltagit i projekt och arbetat med processledning. Har du arbetat som användarstöd för vårdsystem och har erfarenhet av Cosmic är det meriterande.


Du gillar att arbeta i team, tar egna initiativ och arbetar självständigt. Du har förmåga att se helheten i processer och flöden samt gillar att lösa problem. För dig är det lätt att kommunicera på svenska såväl skriftligt som muntligt vilket innebär att du är öppen, tydlig och lyhörd i din kommunikation.

Jobba med IT som gör samhällsnytta! IT-förvaltningen finns till för att underlätta för de olika verksamhetsområdena så att de kan sätta patient och invånare i fokus. I IT-förvaltningen finns cirka 180 medarbetare på orterna Kalmar, Oskarshamn och Västervik.

Vi möter människor i livets alla skeden och har ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete – varje dag.  




Region Kalmar län erbjuder alla medarbetare en anställning på 100%. Om du arbetar deltid men önskar arbeta heltid kan utökning av tjänst erbjudas vid annan arbetsplats. Vi vill att du bifogar CV, personligt brev och för tjänsten relevanta utbildningsbevis till din ansökan. title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Mindler**  

  

Most people suffer from mental health problems at some point in their lives. Mindler was founded in 2018 by two psychologists and one doctor with the vision to enable a world with better mental health. Since then, we have helped thousands of people meet a therapist via our app, with hundreds of clinicians working across five countries. We are known as a leading digital provider of mental health care, and we are now looking for a pragmatic, quality-focused Software Engineer to help build and scale the products driving our care journey.  

  

**What will I be doing?**  

  

As a Software Engineer on our team, you will help build our next-generation web platforms used directly by clinicians and patients in their journey toward better mental health. You will work closely with a low-ego team of product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to architect, implement, and maintain scalable systems.


Key responsibilities include:

* Delivering key features end-to-end from concept through deployment using modern web standards, React, TypeScript, and AWS.
* Designing and maintaining robust RESTful APIs backed by Node.js, optimizing web vitals, ensuring cloud cost-efficiency, and managing relational databases.
* Conducting peer code reviews, maintaining solid test coverage (Vitest, Jest, Playwright), and establishing automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Planning sprints with product managers, leveraging modern AI tooling (such as Copilot or Claude Code) to accelerate delivery, and mentoring peers.

 **Who are you?**

* An experienced Engineer with 5+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience building web applications with TypeScript.
* Deep expertise in React (Hooks, Context API, state management libraries like TanStack Query or Zustand) alongside modern HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI design.
* Strong experience designing RESTful APIs in Node.js, working with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), and deploying applications on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront).
* A DevOps & testing mindset with practical experience with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline) and modern automated testing frameworks.
* A pragmatic problem-solver who values simplicity, takes end-to-end ownership, and communicates clearly in English. Swedish language skills are a bonus.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, Terraform); containerization/observability tools (Docker, Datadog); UI design systems; and web accessibility standards (WCAG) are desirable.

 **What can we offer?**


You will join an international, mission-driven tech organization where you have the trust and freedom to take ownership of your work. We offer a flexible hybrid working structure based out of Stockholm, and a close-knit, low-ego engineering culture focused on making mental healthcare accessible across Europe.


We look forward to receiving your application!


—-

*Mindler is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age.*

title: IT Business Analyst - Finance Domain
description:
**Securitas Group**


Securitas is a world-leading safety and security solutions partner that helps make your world a safer place. By leveraging technology in partnership with our clients, we offer a broad portfolio of value-enhancing services and solutions integrated across the security value chain – from on-site services to advanced monitoring, comprehensive risk prediction and advisory services.


With around 322 000 employees in 44 markets, our innovative, holistic approach with local and global expertise makes us a trusted business partner to many of the world’s best-known companies. Benefitting from almost nine decades of deep experience and guided by our values of integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness, we create sustainable value by helping our clients optimize their operations and protect what matters most - their people and assets.

**Securitas IT**


IT is a key function supporting the capabilities of a modern and powerful IT technology needed to fulfil Securitas business strategy.


In Europe, our 400+ IT co-workers support digital products and services for clients and transforming and protecting our existing IT landscape, making sure colleagues all over the European Division can work efficiently in a modern IT environment.

**About the role**


We are looking for a skilled and pragmatic Business Analyst to strengthen our IT Finance Business Analyst team. This role will support core Finance IT solutions with a focus on AP/AR invoicing and e-invoicing architecture, spanning Basware and our in-house billing engine, across multiple ERP instances and country-specific tax/regulatory frameworks. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at the intersection of finance process design and system architecture, in a complex, multicultural environment.

**Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis & Solution Design**

* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirement documents (BRDs/FRDs), including data flow and integration mapping between ERP, Basware, and the billing engine
* Review, quality-check, and challenge technical designs (interface specs, API contracts, data mappings) for custom development work
* Support the full SDLC — requirements, design, build, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare — for Finance IT initiatives
* Support Finance process areas: Order to Cash (O2C), Procure to Pay (P2P), Record to Report (R2R)
* Support Finance IT roll-outs in new countries, including localization of tax/invoicing requirements and system configuration
* Drive end-to-end process alignment across ERP, e-invoicing platforms, and adjacent systems
* Support test strategy, test case design, and go-live readiness (cutover planning, defect triage)
* Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across invoicing and billing processes
* Coordinate cross-functionally with IT teams, external vendors, and implementation partners

**Operational & User Support**

* Monitor, triage, and follow up on incidents (L2/L3 support) related to invoicing and billing systems
* Support end users in daily operations and troubleshooting
* Ensure efficient, correct, and compliant system usage
* Contribute to platform stability through root-cause analysis and preventive measures

**Security Accountability**

* Ensure compliance with IT security and internal control policies
* Promote secure system usage across finance applications
* Support access control management and segregation of duties (SoD) reviews
* Support follow-up on security incidents and risk remediation
* Support internal/external audits and audit remediation activities

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, IT, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum 4 years' experience as a Business Analyst in an agile environment with ERP applications
* Proven experience with ERP systems, preferably Oracle ERP (Fusion/EBS), including integrations with invoicing platforms such as Basware
* Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable (AR) and the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle
* Working knowledge of multi-country e-invoicing and compliance mechanisms: PEPPOL, government clearance/reporting portals (e.g., KSeF), API-based submission, and batch/file-based uploads
* Solid grasp of tax concepts — VAT, withholding tax, and related statutory compliance requirements
* Familiarity with core billing processes: invoice lifecycle management, credit/debit notes, invoice cancellations and adjustments
* Comfortable working with data (SQL/reporting tools a plus) to investigate issues and validate solution design
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical detail for non-technical stakeholders
* Fluent in English
* Pragmatic, solution-oriented, results-driven
* Ability to manage ambiguity and complexity across systems and geographies

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with country-specific e-invoicing mandates beyond PEPPOL/KSe
* Exposure to Basware configuration or administration (workflow rules, matching logic, connectivity setup) rather than end-user usage only
* Experience with integration/middleware tools (e.g., Oracle Integration Cloud, azure) used to connect ERP, Basware, and the billing engine
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation, reconciliation, and validation of invoicing data
* Familiarity with EDI standards and structured invoice formats (e.g., UBL, XML, CII)
* Prior experience in a shared services or multi-entity, multi-country finance environment
* Exposure to test automation or structured test management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, J)
* Knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident/problem management practices
* Additional European language skills, given the multicultural, multi-country scope of the role
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CBAP, Oracle ERP certifications, Agile/Scrum certifications)

**Current Scope:**

* AP and AR processes in Basware
* E-invoicing flows (PEPPOL, government portals, API/batch submission)
* In-house billing engine
* General Finance process improvement and operational/production support

**What we offer**


At Securitas we believe in doing the right thing and doing it well. For our customers and our employees. Our employees come from all walks of life and bring with them many talents and perspectives. We aim for diverse representation throughout the company, and we are committed to equal pay, safe working conditions, gender balance and an inclusive work environment with a wide range of skills and development opportunities.

**If this sounds like the right next step in your professional career, don't hesitate and apply!**
company_description: Securitas’ mission is to protect homes, workplaces, and communities by providing the security services they need to protect their assets and safeguard their people.

title: Junior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**About the job**
-----------------


Embedded Software Engineers contribute to the software used in our products while working closely with more experienced engineers, interaction designers, system engineers, and other software development teams. They develop their skills in embedded and real-time systems, learning how to create reliable, efficient, and secure software for connected devices. Junior engineers gain experience across different software layers and technologies such as Linux, wireless communication, power management, and device security.

**Key Deliverable**

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of embedded software for Control Units (CU), Linux-based input devices, and battery-operated peripherals as part of new and existing product development.

**Core Tasks**

* Develop and maintain software components for Linux and real-time operating systems under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement software features and bug fixes based on product and system requirements.
* Support the design and implementation of interfaces between software components within a device.
* Participate in code reviews, testing activities, debugging, and troubleshooting.
* Learn and apply best practices for software quality, performance, and maintainability.
* Contribute to optimizing power consumption and system responsiveness where appropriate.
* Follow secure development practices and support the implementation of security requirements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand product needs and system architectures.
* Continuously develop technical skills and knowledge in embedded systems, tools, and development methodologies.

**About Verisure**
------------------


Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.


For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.


Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.


Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

**My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!**


Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.

**Verisure - 35 years of delivering peace of mind.**
----------------------------------------------------

title: System Manager
description:
Är du redo för att hänga med på vår spännande resa? Ellevio är ett av Sveriges största energibolag och tillsammans fortsätter vi att elektrifiera Sverige. Hos oss är du del av en trygg och viktig framtidsbransch samtidigt som du får möjlighet att göra skillnad, växa som individ och ha riktigt kul på vägen! Vi tror på en ljus och hållbar framtid, gör du?


**Om rollen som System Manager**
--------------------------------

Vi står inför stora, spännande tekniska förändringar då vi nu påbörjat arbetet mot ett smartare elnät. Genom att införa modernare teknik och ökad digitalisering så att vi kan förbättra våra leveranser till kunderna och öka effektiviteten i vårt arbete. Denna förändring ställer nya och utökade krav på att vi har moderna och väl fungerande system och plattformar. Därför söker vi nu System Manager som kommer att ha en central roll i vårt arbete framåt.



Som System Manager är du en del av gruppen IT Systems Operations och ansvarar för att säkerställa att våra verksamhetskritiska system är stabila, säkra och utvecklas i takt med verksamhetens behov. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till utvecklingen av framtidens elnät och en robust samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Du fungerar som länken mellan verksamhet, IT och leverantörer. I denna roll får du möjlighet att arbeta med att möjliggöra de förändringar som både vi och energibranschen står inför. Du kommer in i ett spännande skede med flera stora och nya projekt, vilket ställer krav på både IT och verksamhet. Du får goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och mycket flexibilitet med frihet under ansvar.

  

**För att du ska passa och trivas i rollen**
--------------------------------------------



Du trivs i en varierad roll där du får ta stort eget ansvar och där du har möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och utveckling. Du har förmåga att förstå verksamhetens behov, se helheten och prioritera initiativ som skapar långsiktigt värde. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och kräver att du kan samverka med både verksamhet, IT och externa leverantörer. Det är en fördel att ha lätt för att skapa relationer då en stor del av arbetet bygger på samverkan och interaktion med andra, internt och externt. Hos oss behöver du vara engagerad och initiativtagande samtidigt som du tycker om och är bra på att arbeta i team.


### **Vi söker dig som:**


* har högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* har erfarenhet av systemförvaltning eller liknande arbete.
* har erfarenhet av att samordna verksamhet, IT och leverantörer.
* har arbetat med budget och uppföljning av finansiellt resultat.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med SCADA-, ADMS-, GIS- eller andra verksamhetskritiska system inom energi-, industri- eller infrastruktursektorn.

Eftersom mycket av vår kommunikation sker på svenska behöver du kunna svenska i både tal och skrift. Du behöver även ha goda kunskaper i engelska då det förekommer gentemot leverantörer.
**Ellevio som arbetsgivare**
----------------------------



Det är viktigt för oss att medarbetare trivs, känner engagemang och drivs av viljan att kontinuerligt lära nytt och utvecklas. Endast då kan vi tillsammans nå vår vision om en ljus och hållbar framtid. Hos oss får du stora möjligheter att både påverka företaget i stort och din egen karriär. Ett fint bevis på det är att vi mottagit utmärkelsen Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare och även blivit utnämnda till årets Karriärföretag 2021, 2022, 2023 och 2024. Vi arbetar ständigt för ett hållbart och utvecklande arbetsklimat där jämställdhet, mångfald och inkludering är en självklarhet. Till exempel finns ELLE-nätet, Ellevios interna kvinnliga nätverk, för att skapa förutsättningar för ökad samverkan och trivsel.


### **Ta reda på mer!**


* Möt några av dina blivande kollegor
* Läs mer om vårt erbjudande till anställda
* Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess

**Bra för dig att veta om processen!**
--------------------------------------



Låter det här som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan med CV eller Linkedinprofil senast 13 september. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte för länge.



Vid frågor gällande tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Anna Mithander på Anna.Mithander@ellevio.se eller på tel. 070 325 33 60. eller vår rekryterare Alva Ejdsell på alva.ejdsell@ellevio.se.



Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidater och om den aktuella tjänsten är inplacerad i säkerhetsklass innebär det att du, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585), behöver genomgå en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll och bli godkänd i den för att få anställning.



Vi sköter rekryteringen internt och undanber oss därför kontakt från externa leverantörer.
