title: AI Ops Engineer (FBOS)
description:
**TL;DR** 
 — You'll make sure no one at Lovable spends time on anything AI can do. We're defining how AI-native companies operate internally, across Product, GTM, and G&A. You'll own the systems that let a 200-person team move like a 2,000-person company: workflow automations, internal AI tools, data enrichment pipelines. You'll use Lovable itself to build much of this. This role is part of Project Automate Lovable, working closely with our AI Operations & Automation function and FBOS team.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* Shipped production automations at a company: You've built workflow systems at scale that ran without you. Actual business-critical automations used by teams.
* Engineering brain, modern toolkit: You understand how systems actually work (APIs, databases, architecture) and can review code confidently. You move fast by choosing the right tool for the job: AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code etc) when they're faster, no-code (Lovable itself, n8n, Clay, etc.) when it fits, raw code when it's needed.
* Data is part of your building material: You can turn fragmented data across tools, databases, and external sources into reliable, usable systems. You’re comfortable designing data models, writing complex SQL, building enrichment and transformation pipelines, and creating the feedback loops that keep data trustworthy over time.
* AI tool obsessed: You're always testing the latest models, apps, and workflows before anyone else. You've deployed internal AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT with custom contexts, AI agents, MCPs, etc.) at a company and you're constantly experimenting with new ones.
* Can't unsee inefficiency: You see the whole company as one machine. Once you spot a broken process, you can't leave it alone.
* High agency: You don't wait for permission. You find the bottleneck, build the fix, and ship it.


**What You’ll Do**
 Own internal AI systems that make Lovable run faster than it should.
   

  

* Define how AI-native companies operate: Help build the playbook. What we learn here scales to every company using Lovable.
* Build internal tools and workflows: Using Lovable, AI agents, no-code, raw code—whatever gets the job done fastest. Lovable on Lovable first, always.
* Turn company data into operational leverage: Connect and enrich data across our stack, then put it directly to work, powering automations, internal tools, AI agents, decision-making, and proactive workflows across Finance, Business Operations, Legal, etc.
* Deploy AI agent armies: Claude/ChatGPT with MCPs configured so every teammate has AI working for them, not the other way around.
* Squeeze value from our stack: Make the AI features in Slack, Linear, Notion, Ashby, etc. actually deliver.
* Level up the team: Turn everyone at Lovable into AI power users. Document what works. Scale it.
* Own it end-to-end: You build it, you maintain it, you improve it.


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Enhetschef inom applikationsdrift
description:
Sök jobbet
   

  

 Är du en engagerad ledare som skapar förutsättningar för andra att växa och utvecklas? Drivs du av att påverka samhället på riktigt? Då kan det här vara en roll för dig.
   

  

 Om tjänsten
   

  

 Enheten ansvarar för E-hälsomyndighetens applikations- och databasdrift samt SOC-arbete. Du som chef ansvarar för leveransen av it-infrastruktur och relaterad it-drift som används för att möjliggöra alla myndighetens tjänster. Enheten jobbar både i linje och agila team. Du rapporterar till avdelningschefen och ingår i avdelningens ledningsgrupp.
   

  

 I rollen som enhetschef hos oss är ditt viktigaste uppdrag att sätta en vision, utveckla, kommunicera och leverera enhetens uppdrag. Du skapar förutsättningar för att dina medarbetare, både som individer och som team, kan arbeta och utvecklas i rätt riktning. Vi är en organisation i tillväxt och förändring och du är en nyckelperson i att skapa trygghet i riktningen framåt. Du arbetar nära dina chefskollegor och ni ger och får stöd av varandra.
   

  

 Du tillhör avdelningen för digital strategi och plattform. Vi ansvarar utöver drift och support för myndighetens gemensamma digitala plattform, it-strategi och portföljhantering. Detta innefattar att etablera och upprätthålla gemensamma styrande och stödjande strukturer och ramverk.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som är trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap. Du är samarbetsinriktad och skapar relationer på alla nivåer i organisationen. Du leder i förändring och kommer med idéer på hur verksamheten och individer kan utvecklas. I din förändringsledning är du strategisk och tar ett helhetsperspektiv. Det är en självklarhet för dig att ta ansvar för såväl ditt eget arbete som för fattade beslut.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* akademisk utbildning om minst 180 hp (120 gamla poäng) inom relevant område alternativt likvärdig arbetslivserfarenhet

title: Senior AWS Solutions Architect
description:
**Pratar du flytande AWS?** 


 (...och kan förklara det för våra kunder som inte gör det?)
 




  





 Som Solutions Architect blir du säkert uppvaktad av bolag som lovar allt från "spännande resor" till "agila miljöer". Vi tänkte kort och gott bara berätta hur det är att jobba på Alto.
 



  





 Vi är en mindre oberoende AWS-partner i Stockholm (Advanced Tier Partner) med kunduppdrag på både nystartade startups till etablerade tech-bolag. Vi designar och bygger säkra och skalbara molnlösningar. Vi är snabbfotade, nyfikna, vetgiriga och har roligt på vägen. Och vi gillar att fira framgångar! Senast firade vi två kollegor som blivit AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
 



  





**Vad du kommer att göra** 




 Du kommer att ha en central, strategisk roll hos oss. Du stöttar oss med teknisk kompetens i kundmöten, implementerar lösningar, leder workshops och designar lösningar åt våra kunder.
 



  





**Vem vi letar efter** 




 Vi vet att AI har konkurrerat ut traditionell utveckling. Framtiden är AI-driven. Med din breda tekniska kompetens förväntas du utvecklas med den tekniken.
 



  





 Du har förmodligen en akademisk bakgrund och har spenderat några år i arkitektur- eller seniora teknikroller. Vi arbetar med samhälls- och affärskritiska system så svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav. Erfarenhet av startups/Scaleups och produktbolag är ett plus, likaså om du redan sitter på en AWS-certifiering. Att du är van vid att kommunicera med både tekniker och icke-tekniska intressenter ser vi som en självklarhet.
 



  





**Livslångt lärande, enkelhet och omtanke** 




 På Alto delar vi kunskap. Så vi hoppas att även du delar med dig av dina erfarenheter och insikter. I gengäld lovar vi en miljö där vi sponsrar din egen fortsatta utbildning och dina certifieringar. Vi firar, analyserar problem utan prestige och bjuder varandra på tekniska djupdykningar.
 



  






 Vi erbjuder dig:
 





 🔹
 
 Korta beslutsvägar.
 




 🔹
 
 Möjlighet till delägarskap.
 




 🔹
 
 Chansen att prägla Altos kultur och struktur i en fas där varje medarbetare gör verklig skillnad.
 




 🔹
 
 Roliga uppdrag inom den senaste AI/Cloud tekniken.
 



  





 Vi har en stark företagskultur som bygger på omtanke, enkelhet och livslång lärande, där alla blir sedda, hörda och accepterade som den man är.
 



  





 Du bestämmer själv över dina arbetstider (med hänsyn till kunden) och vi har ett riktigt härligt kontor på Slottsbacken där det bjuds på tekniksnack, frukostar och bra kaffe. Vi ser gärna att du vill och kan hänga med oss här under veckodagarna.
 



 Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

title: CTO / Lead Developer - Platform Team
description:
Hacksaw Studios is looking for a highly experienced CTO / Lead Developer to join and lead our platform team.
   

  

 The platform team is responsible for building, maintaining, and continuously improving the core remote gaming server platform used across the group. This is a high-volume, transactional system operating in the online gaming industry, where scalability, security, reliability, and code quality are critical.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You will take ownership of the ongoing development and maintenance of the remote gaming server platform, as well as other platform-related services including API gateway solutions, back-office systems, integrations, and future unannounced projects.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As CTO / Lead Developer for the platform team, you will be expected to combine strong technical leadership with hands-on development. You will work closely with the engineering team, senior management, and other departments to ensure that our platform continues to scale, perform, and meet the high standards required in a regulated industry.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving technical decisions, improving architecture, reviewing and writing code, mentoring developers, and ensuring that the platform remains stable, secure, and maintainable as the business grows.
   

  

 A key part of the role will also be communication. You will need to clearly explain technical decisions, platform changes, risks, priorities, and ongoing work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This includes regular reporting to senior management, as well as close collaboration with departments such as Frontend, DevOps, Sysadmin, and Support to ensure they understand the platform, upcoming changes, operational impact, and how best to support the systems in production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical direction and development of the remote gaming server platform
* Take ownership of platform architecture, scalability, performance, and security
* Write, review, and deliver high-quality C# code
* Maintain and improve core transactional systems handling high volumes of traffic
* Work with SQL databases and ensure strong data integrity, performance, and reliability
* Support and improve related platform services, including API gateways and back-office systems
* Report progress, priorities, risks, and technical decisions to senior management
* Communicate clearly with DevOps, sysadmin, support, and other departments about platform functionality, changes, incidents, and operational requirements
* Help educate relevant teams on how the platform works and how changes may affect their areas
* Promote strong engineering practices, including unit testing, code reviews, and maintainable architecture
* Help the team operate effectively in a highly regulated industry
* Mentor and support developers while remaining deeply involved in day-to-day implementation
* Contribute to future platform initiatives and new technical projects


**Requirements**
* Extensive professional experience with C# and .NET
* Strong experience building scalable, production-grade backend systems
* Very strong SQL skills, including performance optimization and data modelling
* Understanding of caching principles in Redis or similar
* Experience working with transaction-based systems, ideally in online gaming, fintech, payments, trading, or similar industries
* Experience designing and operating horizontally scaled systems
* Strong understanding of system architecture, API design, reliability, and security
* Experience working with high-volume systems where uptime and correctness are critical
* A strong focus on code quality, testing, and maintainability
* Comfortable being hands-on and spending a significant amount of time coding
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience working across departments such as DevOps, infrastructure, support, product, or operations
* Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving environment


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience from the online gaming or gambling industry
* Experience working in regulated environments
* Experience with remote gaming server platforms, payment systems, or other mission-critical transactional platforms
* Experience designing analytics systems for handling very large data sets for reporting purposes
* Experience leading engineering teams or acting as a technical owner for a major platform
* Experience with back-office systems, API gateways and integrations into third-party systems
* Experience reporting to or working directly with senior management


 What we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone who enjoys taking real technical ownership who is a strong, hands-on developer. You should be excited by complex backend systems, care deeply about quality, and be comfortable balancing long-term architecture with hands-on delivery.
   

  

 You should be able to lead from the front, contribute directly to the codebase, and help the team make good technical decisions while keeping the platform secure, scalable, and reliable.
   

  

 Just as importantly, you should be a strong communicator. The platform team works closely with DevOps, sysadmin, support, and senior management, and this role will be expected to create clarity across those teams. You should be comfortable explaining what the platform team is doing, why certain technical decisions are being made, what risks or priorities exist, and how other departments are affected.
   

  

**About Hacksaw**
 Hacksaw is a fast-growing company in the online gaming industry, building products and platforms used by operators and players across multiple markets. We work in a highly regulated environment and place strong emphasis on quality, reliability, and responsible technical delivery.
   

  

 If you are an experienced C# developer and technical leader who wants to take ownership of a critical high-volume gaming platform, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

 Practical Details
   

  

* This is an on-site position in Stockholm.


 Ready to Join the Game Makers?
   

  

 Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Music Monetization & DRM
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world
 *feel* 
 your work.** 




  





 We are looking for two Senior Backend Engineers to join our team. Your primary responsibility will revolve around Digital Rights Management (DRM) with a specific emphasis on social media platforms, where YouTube currently represents our predominant focus. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of music rights within the dynamic digital landscape.
 



  





 You'll leverage Google cloud services to enhance operations and contribute to innovative, efficient solutions. The role involves engaging with large datasets to derive data-driven insights, informing decisions for Epidemic Sound's revenue operations. The position offers a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, and teamwork drives success. Additionally, you'll contribute to smart decision-making processes affecting revenue operations.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities Include** 



* Support our mission to make claiming and safelisting content smooth and secure for all users
* Take ownership of services end to end, including the infrastructure and monitoring around them
* Point us in the right direction when building services for our customers
* Monitor and optimise services that fetch and analyse data from UGC platforms like YouTube
* Work closely with data and machine learning engineers to ensure that our business operations can make the right decisions



  





**About You** 




 Experience with a strong command of backend technologies, you excel in designing, optimising and maintaining the core infrastructure that ensures our services run smoothly. Your expertise is particularly valuable when dealing with high-availability systems and complex partner API integrations.
 



  





 Your proficiency extends to processing and managing large data volumes efficiently, all while adhering to the stringent compliance requirements of social media platforms. Your technical acumen is most notable in designing services that are simple to reason about and straightforward for the next person to pick up.
 



  





 Moreover, your interest in areas such as Digital Rights Management (DRM) underscores your commitment to addressing backend challenges in handling and safeguarding large-scale datasets. Your contributions play a vital role in maintaining the integrity and reliability of our backend systems.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* Experience in backend development, ideally in Go, which is what we build our services in today
* Data expertise: excel in processing and evaluating large volumes of data, with proficiency in SQL for data processing and integration tasks
* Experience in algorithm evaluation, including testing and analysis of outputs
* Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud Platform
* Comfortable building microservices, whether event-driven or request/response.
* Comfortable owning your infrastructure end to end (Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform)
* Strong communication skills: excel in English both written and verbal communication, crucial for collaboration and understanding in our global team



  





 Nice to have
 


* Proficiency in Kotlin, Java or Python is an advantage
* Some TypeScript and React, enough to build small internal tools yourself
* Interest in DRM protocols and practices is a bonus
* Familiarity with audio formats, codecs or streaming is a plus
* Exposure to machine learning systems in production is welcome



  





**Equal opportunity employer** 




 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
 



  





**Application** 




 Ready to make the world
 *feel* 
 your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer

 With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.
   

  





 At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters. — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.
   

  





 We’re shaping how work should feel, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.
   

  





**Who we are**

 We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

title: Redovisningsekonom till tillverkande industribolag
description:
ill du kombinera klassisk redovisning med affärssystem, processutveckling och verksamhetsnära arbete? Vi söker nu en redovisningsekonom för ett konsultuppdrag hos ett svenskt tillverkande industribolag med global verksamhet och en stark produktnära miljö.


Rollen passar dig som är trygg inom redovisning men som också tycker att det är spännande att förstå hur ekonomi, affärssystem, lager, material och produktion hänger ihop.


Uppdraget är initialt ett konsultuppdrag på cirka sex månader, med ambitionen att därefter övergå till en anställning direkt hos kund.


Om rollen
Kunden befinner sig i en pågående implementation av IFS Cloud, där ekonomiavdelningen har en central roll i att säkerställa välfungerande processer, dataflöden och arbetssätt.


Som redovisningsekonom kommer du inledningsvis att ha ett tydligt fokus på ERP-implementeringen. Du kommer bland annat att bidra i testning och kvalitetssäkring samt arbeta med att säkerställa att de ekonomiska processerna fungerar som de ska i det nya systemet.


Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med såväl ekonomiavdelningen som andra delar av verksamheten. För att lyckas behöver du kunna förstå hur olika händelser i verksamheten – exempelvis kopplade till lager, material och produktion – påverkar de ekonomiska flödena.


När implementationen kommit längre kommer rollen successivt att övergå till att även innehålla mer traditionella arbetsuppgifter inom redovisning.


Dina arbetsuppgifter
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* Delta i testning och kvalitetssäkring i samband med implementationen av IFS Cloud
* Bidra till utveckling och förbättring av ekonomiska processer och flöden
* Arbeta nära ekonomiavdelningen och övriga verksamheten i frågor kopplade till affärssystem och redovisning
* Säkerställa och utveckla ekonomiflöden kopplade till bland annat lager, material och produktion
* Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter i arbetssätt och systemprocesser
* På sikt arbeta med löpande redovisning och andra förekommande arbetsuppgifter inom ekonomifunktionen

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet som redovisningsekonom och som vill arbeta i en roll där redovisning kombineras med system, processer och verksamhetsutveckling.


Du är noggrann och strukturerad samtidigt som du är nyfiken på hur ekonomifunktionen hänger ihop med verksamheten i stort. Du trivs med att samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen och har förmågan att både sätta dig in i detaljer och förstå helheten i ett industriellt flöde.


Ett intresse för affärssystem och förbättringsarbete är viktigt, och vi ser gärna att du tidigare har varit delaktig i systemimplementationer, systembyten eller liknande förändringsprojekt.


Skallkrav
* Minst två års erfarenhet som redovisningsekonom
* Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri
* God erfarenhet av arbete i ERP-/affärssystem
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande
Det är meriterande om du har:

* Erfarenhet av ERP-implementationer
* Erfarenhet av systembyten eller större förändringsprojekt
* Arbetat som superuser eller key user inom ekonomi
* Erfarenhet av IFS eller IFS Cloud
* Förståelse för ekonomiflöden kopplade till lager, material och produktion

Om uppdraget
Detta är initialt ett konsultuppdrag på cirka sex månader där du blir anställd som konsult och arbetar ute hos vår kund. Ambitionen är att uppdraget därefter ska övergå till en direktanställning hos kund.


För rätt person finns därmed möjlighet att komma in i verksamheten i ett spännande skede, bidra till en viktig systemförändring och på sikt bli en långsiktig del av organisationen.

**Låter detta som din nästa utmaning?**


Vad kul! Skicka in din ansökan så hör vi av oss för ett nästa steg i processen.


Som konsult hos oss på Job Solution Consulting omfattas man av en trygg anställning i nära dialog med sin konsultchef för att alltid säkerställa att du trivs och utvecklas i din roll. Vi erbjuder en rad förmåner med fokus på kompetensutveckling och välmående, Och självklart omfattas man också av kollektivavtal i sin tjänst hos oss. För eventuella frågor eller funderingar är du välkommen att höra av dig till mig.


Du når mig på fredrik.hovstadius@jobsolution.se.

title: Senior Network Security Consultant
description:
Cuebid Syd AB | Malmö, Sweden | Full-time · On-site
  
About the Role
  
Cuebid Syd AB is looking for a Senior Network Security Consultant to join our team in Malmö, Sweden.
  
This is a senior consulting role where you will work across customer projects, designing, deploying and securing enterprise network environments.
  
The role requires deep hands-on expertise in Aruba (HPE Aruba Networking), including switching, campus access architecture, ClearPass and Aruba Central, combined with strong experience in Fortinet secure networking technologies, including FortiGate, FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.
  
We welcome applications from qualified candidates both in Sweden and internationally. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, and candidates currently living abroad must be willing to relocate to the Malmö region.
  
About Cuebid
  
Cuebid Syd AB is part of Cuebid, a Swedish IT infrastructure and cybersecurity company founded in 2009 with a clear purpose: to build robust and secure IT infrastructure, with security at the core of everything we do.
  
Our first customers included some of Sweden’s largest banks, and organisations with high demands on availability, security, integrity and trust continue to represent an important part of our customer base.
  
Today, Cuebid has close to 100 employees, with specialist expertise primarily within three areas: Network & Communication, Datacenter and Security Operations. Our experts hold some of the industry’s highest-level certifications, and we continuously invest in developing our skills as technology and the cybersecurity threat landscape evolve.
  
Cuebid remains owned by its founders and employees and is built on a strong and stable financial foundation. We believe in sustainable, organic growth and in building long-term relationships with our customers, employees and technology partners.
  
We currently have offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö, while supporting customers throughout Sweden, across the Nordic region and internationally.
  
As part of Cuebid Syd AB in Malmö, you will join a specialist-driven organisation where technical expertise, customer trust and long-term development are central to how we work.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Design and architect secure switching and campus access solutions using Aruba (HPE Aruba Networking) technologies for customer environments.
  
Own network access control (NAC) strategy, policy enforcement and troubleshooting using ClearPass.
  
Deploy, configure and administer Fortinet secure networking solutions, including FortiGate, across customer projects.
  
Manage centralized security operations, policies and reporting through FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.
  
Perform network security assessments, risk analysis and infrastructure hardening initiatives for customers.
  
Support integration of customers’ on-premises networks with hybrid and cloud environments, including VMware and Microsoft Azure.
  
Produce clear technical documentation, network diagrams and architecture standards.
  
Act as a senior technical escalation point and mentor for network and security engineers.
  
Work directly with customer stakeholders as a trusted technical and security advisor across multiple projects.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
Extensive senior-level experience in enterprise networking and network security, typically 10+ years, with recent hands-on experience in consulting or architecture.
  
Strong Aruba Networking expertise in switching and campus access design.
  
Hands-on experience with Aruba ClearPass for NAC, policy and secure access.
  
Strong Fortinet secure networking experience, including FortiGate, FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.
  
Strong understanding of enterprise routing, switching, firewalling and security architecture.
  
Excellent communication and customer-facing skills.
  
Professional fluency in English.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
HPE Aruba Networking Expert/Architect-level certifications.
  
Fortinet NSE 6/NSE 7 or equivalent current Fortinet certifications.
  
FortiManager and/or Enterprise Firewall certifications.
  
Microsoft Azure certifications.
  
VMware and hybrid-cloud experience.
  
Experience with service-provider or telecom networks, including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS and MPLS.
  
Swedish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.
  
  

Additional Skills
  
Strong management and leadership skills are highly valued. You should be comfortable leading technical engagements, coordinating project teams and managing customer relationships.
  
What We Offer
  
A senior technical role with significant responsibility and influence.
  
The opportunity to lead complex network and cybersecurity projects across a variety of customers.
  
Work with enterprise customers and leading networking and cybersecurity technologies.
  
Professional development and opportunities for further certification.
  
A specialist-driven environment with highly experienced colleagues.
  
Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
  
  

International Candidates
  
We welcome applications from qualified international candidates.
  
The position is based at Cuebid Syd AB in Malmö, Sweden, and the successful candidate must be willing to relocate to the Malmö region.
  
How to Apply
  
Please submit your CV together with a short description of your experience with Aruba Networking, ClearPass and Fortinet technologies.
  
Applications will be evaluated based on qualifications and relevant professional experience.
  
Öppen för alla

title: Specialist, Business Support, London
description:
Are you interested in working with payroll & accounting in an international and client-facing environment? Do you have experience from payroll & bookkeeping / accounting? We are now looking for a Business Support Specialist to join our engaged and collaborative team in London. Business Sweden's Business Support Services team provides high-quality finance, payroll, accounting and administrative services in our local offices around the world. We help Swedish companies scale internationally by delivering reliable back-office operations, compliance support and practical advisory. We see a growing demand in the UK for our services in this field. We are looking for a proactive and experienced Business Support Services Specialist to join our team full time. You will be responsible for local payroll and accounting operations, financial reporting, and delivering accurate, timely administration for our clients and internal stakeholders. The role combines hands-on bookkeeping and payroll processing with client communication and continuous improvement of processes. You will work independently and in teams but it will be your clear objective to manage your own project deliveries on budget, time and with excellent quality. The role includes both strategic, tactic and operational responsibilities such as: Take full ownership of payroll processing for multiple entities, including salary calculations, tax withholdings, social security contributions and statutory filings.
  
**Manage monthly bookkeeping:** record transactions, reconcile accounts, maintain ledgers and prepare journal entries.
  
Prepare monthly financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and supporting analyses for local management and the Swedish parent company.
  
Handle accounts payable and receivable, vendor and bank payments, and invoice follow-up.
  
Coordinate and prepare documentation for audits, tax filings and statutory reporting, and liaise with external accountants and tax advisors.
  
Maintain payroll and accounting records in compliance with local laws and group policies; ensure payroll-related taxes and social contributions are filed and paid on time.
  
Provide client-facing support and advisory on payroll and accounting questions; identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve service delivery.
  
Manage our Process Agent offering (no previous experience necessary).
  
The role is based in London, but you will have a chance to collaborate with our teams and clients around the world, as required. The role is a full-time position and we apply probationary employment in all applicable positions. Core competencies and collaborative skills • Demonstrate commitment, honesty, and accountability in tasks. • Strong attention to detail, structured working style and ability to meet recurring deadlines. • Service-oriented, proactive and able to work independently as well as part of a small team. • A problem solver who easily adapts to new ways of working. • Voice your own ideas and share opinions. Show appreciation for different perspectives. • Good communication skills: you can explain payroll and accounting matters clearly to non-finance colleagues and clients. Formal requirements • Relevant education (Accounting, Finance, Payroll certification or equivalent) • Minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience, preferably in payroll / accounting roles • Practical experience with payroll processing and local payroll legislation, including hands-on experience preparing statutory payroll filings. • Solid bookkeeping/accounting experience (monthly close, reconciliations, P&L and balance sheet preparation). • Familiarity with payroll and accounting software and bank/payment systems; experience with local and cloud-based accounting systems is an advantage, especially Xero. • You have a high level of proficiency in English, meriting with Swedish • Right to work in the UK A Plus • Professional experiences from Swedish companies Application Please submit your CV and a short cover letter explaining your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining Business Sweden's Business Support Services team. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Start date is immediate.

title: Senior CAD Technician - Wet Utilities
description:
Job Description The Senior CAD / Plant 3D Modeller role is focused on high-quality CAD and 3D modelling production for water and wastewater treatment projects supporting Sweden/Nordic delivery teams. The position requires deep technical expertise in Autodesk Plant 3D, strong attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional teams. Responsibilities 3D modelling: Develop and update piping and equipment models in Autodesk Plant 3D (2022 or later) based on P&IDs, layouts, vendor drawings, and engineering inputs.
  
**Drawing production:** Generate orthographic drawings, general arrangements, sections, elevations, and piping isometrics.
  
**P&ID development:** Prepare smart P&IDs and support updates under engineer direction.
  
**QA and standards:** Ensure compliance with ISO, SSG, SIS standards; deliver models in accordance with LOD up to 400; apply QA processes to own and others' work.
  
**Pipe and support modelling:** Model piping systems, valves, supports, and local steel items per ISO/SSG standards.
  
**Hydraulic profile:** Support creation of hydraulic profiles and integration into models.
  
**Spec and reporting tools:** Active use of Plant Spec Editor and Plant Report Creator.
  
**Pressure/stress analysis:** Perform or coordinate pressure control and stress analysis using ROHR2, CAESAR II, or similar tools.
  
**Clash detection:** Use Navisworks for model review, walkthroughs, and clash checking.
  
**Material take-off:** Extract BOMs, line lists, and MTOs from models.
  
**Collaboration:** Work closely with engineers, BIM leads, and cross-discipline teams; communicate technical solutions clearly.
  
Qualifications Diploma/Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering, Drafting, or relevant technical discipline.
  
8-15 years of CAD/piping detailing experience, with at least 4-5 years hands-on in Autodesk Plant 3D.
  
Proven experience in water/wastewater projects, piping systems, and treatment skids.
  
Familiarity with Swedish/Nordic codes and standards (ISO, SSG, SIS).
  
Experience across design and construction phases.
  
Exposure to point cloud/Recap workflows for brownfield projects desirable.
  
Essential Skills Advanced Autodesk Plant 3D modelling and AutoCAD 2D drafting.
  
QA process knowledge and ability to deliver models to LOD 400.
  
Strong command of orthographic/isometric drawing extraction.
  
Ability to prepare ISO drawings for pipe routing, weld points, prefabrication splits, and BOM adjustments.
  
Effective communication and teamwork across disciplines.
  
Soft Skills & Attributes Attention to detail and disciplined approach to modelling.
  
Initiative in quality assurance and proactive resolution of technical issues.
  
Strong communication skills; ability to explain technical solutions clearly.
  
Positive attitude to training, standardization, and mentoring junior CAD staff.
  
Team-oriented mindset with adaptability to project needs.
  
**BGV:** Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  
Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner".

description:

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Som VD / operativ ledare får du ett övergripande ansvar för verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling, med fokus på drift, ledarskap, kommersiell styrning och långsiktig tillväxt. Rollen är både strategisk och verksamhetsnära, och kräver att du trivs i en miljö där struktur, människor, gästupplevelse och affär går hand i hand.



Du kommer att arbeta nära ägare/styrelse och organisationen i arbetet med att vidareutveckla bolagets arbetssätt, ledarskap och framtida expansionsmodell.



Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter


* Leda och utveckla bolagets verksamhet tillsammans med organisationen.
* Ansvara för budget, resultat, uppföljning och relevanta nyckeltal.
* Leda, coacha och utveckla andra nyckelpersoner.
* Arbeta med kommersiella initiativ, lokal försäljning och gästupplevelse.
* Bidra till bolagets fortsatta utveckling av expansions-, franchise- eller partnerstruktur.
* Rapportera till ägare/styrelse.


Placeringsort: Västsverige, med närvaro i bolagets restaurangenheter.


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Jani Lassila
Cloud engineer på Shibuya
*"Det är roligt med ett jobb där man utvecklas hela tiden. Det kommer nya produkter och nya lösningar hela tiden inom containerområdet, så det blir aldrig så att man blir färdiglärd."*
Elin Holmqvist
Support engineer på Shibuya
*"Att börja på Shibuya efter nio år på mitt tidigare jobb har varit fantastiskt roligt! Jag har lärt mig så mycket nytt och lär mig fortfarande. Jag förstår inte varför jag inte gjorde detta tidigare."*
Eva-Lott Kullberg
Ekonomi och lön på Pulsen Group
*"Att jobba på Pulsen är för min del en resa framåt, där arbetet aldrig står still. Man får vara med om en fantastisk utveckling och ny kunskap tillsammans med ett härligt gäng duktiga kollegor."*
Cecilia Andersson
Affärsområdesansvarig på Pulsen Omsorg
*"På Pulsen Omsorg får jag arbeta med innovation och har stort förtroende från ledningen att driva projekt framåt. Här uppskattas mitt arbete, och det gör jobbet både engagerande och roligt."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Kvalifikationer**



Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av ledande ansvar inom restaurang, fast casual, franchise, retail, hospitality eller annan närliggande verksamhet med flera enheter.



Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:


* Operativt ledarskap i restaurang- eller serviceverksamhet.
* Resultatansvar, budget och affärsuppföljning.
* Att leda chefer eller nyckelpersoner i en multi-site-miljö.
* Personal, bemanning, schemaläggning och daglig drift.
* Kommersiell utveckling, försäljning och lönsamhetsarbete.
* Franchise, partnerdrift eller ägarledd verksamhet är meriterande.


**Personliga egenskaper**



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är affärsmässig, operativ och strukturerad. Du har förmåga att kombinera entreprenöriellt driv med tydlig uppföljning och ansvarstagande. Du är trygg i att fatta beslut, leda andra och skapa framdrift tillsammans med organisationen.



Vi tror också att du är:


* Kommersiellt orienterad.
* Praktisk och lösningsorienterad.
* Tydlig och närvarande i ditt ledarskap.
* Van att skapa struktur och följa upp resultat.
* Bekväm i en entreprenöriell miljö.
* Intresserad av mat, service och gästupplevelse.


**Ansökan**



Välkommen med din ansökan. Urval sker löpande.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* En miljö präglad av utveckling och innovation
* Goda utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter
* Fokus på ett hållbart arbetsliv
* En entreprenöriell förändringsresa
* Svenskägd koncern med verksamhet i olika branscher
* Personliga möten och ett långsiktigt tänk
**Om företaget**
----------------

Omami är ett svenskt fast casual-koncept inom Asian street food med flera restaurangenheter i Västsverige. Bolaget har etablerat ett uppskattat koncept och befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas där fokus ligger på att fortsätta bygga en tydlig, hållbar och skalbar plattform för framtiden.


TOMVår grundare, Wigar Bartholdson, spelade fotboll i elitserien för Elfsborg och fick 1964 erbjudande om ett proffskontrakt i en Schweizisk fotbollsklubb. Han tackade nej till detta och startade istället företaget ”Datakonsult Wigar Bartholdson” som sedan 1984 heter Pulsen.


TOMVi har sedan starten vuxit från ett renodlat IT-bolag till en koncern som omfattar allt från hustillverkning till regnkläder och sedan 2017 är det Jonus Bartholdson som är koncernens VD.


TOM2025 blev vi utsedda både till Karriärföretag för sjätte året i rad av Karriärföretagen och till ”Sweden’s best managed companies” för femte året i rad av Deloitte. Vår VD blev, av Karriärföretagen, utsedd till årets VD inom kategorin IT/Tech 2024.


TOMVi är hållbarhetspartner för Elitfotboll Dam samt presenting partner för Elitettan. Tillsammans ska vi verka för en hållbar utveckling av flick- och damfotbollen.

title: Redovisningsekonom med ERP-intresse - Linköpingsområdet
description:
Vill du kombinera redovisning med affärssystem och industriella processer? Här får du en central roll i en pågående IFS Cloud-implementering med möjlighet till övergång i anställning.

### **Vi söker dig som**

Vi söker en redovisningsekonom till ett konsultuppdrag hos ett svenskt tillverkande industribolag med global verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som har några års erfarenhet inom redovisning och trivs i skärningspunkten mellan ekonomi, affärssystem och förbättringsarbete.


Du kommer in i en pågående implementation av IFS Cloud där ekonomiavdelningen har en viktig roll i att säkerställa fungerande processer, dataflöden och arbetssätt. Initialt ligger därför stort fokus på system, testning och kvalitetssäkring, medan rollen på sikt även omfattar mer traditionella redovisningsuppgifter.

### **Arbetsuppgifter**

* Delta i testning och kvalitetssäkring kopplat till IFS Cloud.
* Bidra till utveckling och förbättring av ekonomiska processer och flöden.
* Arbeta nära ekonomiavdelningen och övriga verksamheten i frågor som rör affärssystem och redovisning.
* Arbeta med ekonomiflöden kopplade till lager, material och produktion.
* På sikt stötta i löpande redovisning och andra sedvanliga ekonomiarbetsuppgifter.

### **Obligatoriska krav**

* Minst 2 års erfarenhet som redovisningsekonom.
* Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri.
* God erfarenhet av ERP-/affärssystem.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

### **Meriterande krav**

* Erfarenhet av ERP-implementationer.
* Erfarenhet av systembyten eller större förändringsprojekt.
* Erfarenhet som superuser eller key user inom ekonomi.
* Förståelse för ekonomiflöden kopplade till lager, material och produktion.

### **Om uppdraget**

**Plats:** Väderstad  

**Omfattning:** Heltid, 100 %  

**Period:** 21 september 2026 – 21 mars 2027  

**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse  

**Sista ansökningsdag:** 6 september 2026  

**Affärssystem:** IFS Cloud  

**Uppdragsform:** Konsultuppdrag med ambition om övergång till anställning hos kund efter cirka 6 månader  

**Förlängning:** Möjlighet till förlängning finns.


Eftersom ambitionen är att uppdraget ska övergå i en anställning efter cirka sex månader behöver du vara införstådd med angivet lönetak redan från start.


Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera redovisning med ett tydligt system- och processfokus i en produktnära, internationell tillverkningsmiljö.


Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.


Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: System Consultant - Storage
description:
**Date de publication :** Aug 25, 2026, 10:30AM
  
Join Orange Business in Oslo or Stockholm to operate and evolve critical storage and backup infrastructure, collaborate with experts, and grow with tomorrow’s technology.The team, position & mission:
  
The Systems Consultant – Storage is a technical role within the Compute & Storage department. The Storage team works closely with Compute (Virtualization) to deliver stable, predictable and reliable infrastructure services.
  
  

The team is primarily responsible for our storage infrastructure, across both shared and dedicated platforms. To succeed in this role, you should be a natural team player with strong initiative, flexibility and a proactive mindset. In the Storage team, we value quality awareness, structure and a continuous improvement mindset. If you are solution-oriented and eager to learn new technologies, this role offers a strong opportunity to develop your career within Storage and make a meaningful contribution to the industry.
  
  

The main responsibilities in this role include monitoring, operations and maintenance of Storage systems and infrastructure, with a particular focus on backup solutions, including image backup. The team currently consists of one manager, one team lead and 10 employees across Norway and Sweden, with plans to expand to 12 employees. Compute & Storage is one department consisting of two teams: Storage and Compute. The department places strong emphasis on continuous development, ensuring that we stay aligned with the latest technologies and industry’s best practices.
  
  

The consultant will be responsible for monitoring, operations, maintenance and development of Storage services, and will contribute to both internal initiatives and customer-facing projects. The role requires strong expertise across a range of storage and backup solutions. The role may occasionally involve direct customer dialogue, such as participation in sales meetings or advisory discussions, although this is not a primary responsibility. Close collaboration with Compute (Virtualization) is important, and general knowledge of VMware is considered an advantage. All case handling is managed through ServiceNow, so experience with ServiceNow is an advantage. The consultant should be curious, eager to contribute, and motivated by helping others develop and succeed.
  
  

Your key areas of responsibility as System Consultant - Storage:
  
  

* Operate and maintain Orange storage solutions.
* Operate and maintain Orange backup solutions.
* Implement new solutions.
* Participate in internal and customer projects.
* Support customer teams with incoming requests.
* Documentation
* Contribute to capacity management.
* Provide 2nd and 3rd line support.
* Act as a driving force and active contributor to the continued development of Storage solutions.


**As an ideal candidate you have:**  

* Knowledge of different storage technologies, including all or some of these: Block Storage, File Storage and Object Storage. Relevant systems include NetApp, HPE Primera/Alletra, Dell PowerScale and IBM FlashSystem.
* Good knowledge of backup solutions such as Rubrik, Cohesity and TSM.
* In-depth knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux/Unix.
* Basic networking knowledge is an advantage.
* Hardware competence.
* A strong team orientation and enjoyment of collaborative work.


It is not a requirement, but other preferred qualifications would be:
  
  

* General understanding of VMware virtualization technology.
* Scripting knowledge, including Bash, PowerShell and Python.


**Some of the systems used:**  

* Optical DWDM Solutions: SmartOptics DCP-M
* IBM Flashsystem
* HPE Primera/Alletra
* Dell PowerScale
* NetApp (StorageGrid, FAS, BlockStorage)

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Consultant)
description:
About the Role
  
We're looking for a senior engineer who can hit the ground running in complex client environments and bring both technical depth and delivery ownership to the table. You'll be embedded with clients across fintech, insurance, SaaS, and enterprise software — leading backend architecture, driving frontend quality, and mentoring the engineers around you.
  
This is a hands-on role. We need someone who writes production code, makes architectural calls, and communicates trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  
What You'll Do
  
* Design and build scalable, cloud-native applications using TypeScript, Node.js, and React
* Architect backend services using NestJS, GraphQL, and microservices patterns on AWS
* Lead database design and optimization across PostgreSQL and Redis
* Drive CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud deployments
* Work across async messaging layers (Kafka, SQS) in distributed system contexts
* Build and maintain real-time communication features using WebRTC and peer-to-peer protocols
* Consult directly with client engineering leads on architecture and delivery strategy
* Collaborate across US and Nordic client teams, navigating time zones, communication styles, and delivery expectations
* Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to technical standards across the team


What We're Looking For
  
* 5+ years in full stack development with a polyglot background (TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET, SQL)
* Strong command of Node.js backend frameworks, particularly NestJS
* React expertise at scale, including performance optimization and component architecture
* Solid AWS depth: Lambda, S3, EC2, RDS, SQS, and ideally ECS or EKS
* Hands-on experience with WebRTC and real-time communication systems in production
* Proven track record working with US-based clients or teams in an embedded or consulting model
* Familiarity with Nordic engineering culture and workplace norms — direct communication, flat hierarchies, delivery autonomy
* Comfort owning delivery in a consulting or embedded team model — not just executing tickets
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially with non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have
  
* Experience building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain/LangGraph)
* Familiarity with agentic development workflows or spec-driven delivery approaches
* C#/.NET background for legacy system contexts
* Prior exposure to regulated industries such as insurance, fintech, or telecom


Why This Role
  
You'll work across real product teams, not just maintenance accounts. We run lean embedded teams with clear accountability, and we give experienced engineers room to shape how work gets done — not just what gets built. Our client base spans the US and Nordics, so you'll bring cross-market perspective that most candidates simply don't have.

title: Senior Software Platform Engineer
description:
Do you want to join the technological revolution? Tendium is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team.
  
About Tendium
  
Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyze, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
  
If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it here.
  
What you'll do
  
Our Platform team has a broad and exciting ownership. As a member of our Platform team you will build foundational services that all our features need, security and developer experience as well as being in the forefront of AI development. You will make sure that we have the AI tooling we need to build with both speed and quality, and that our platform is secure and easy to monitor and work with. This is a role where you will spend time on building our product and internal tools as well as building SRE guidelines and best practices cross-team. The whole tech organisation consists of approximately 20 engineers split into different teams, where everyone knows each other.
  
  

**Tech stack:**  

Microservice Architecture.
  
**AWS based infrastructure:** Fargate, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, GraphQL, OpenAPI
  
**Databases and Querying:** DocumentDB (MongoDB), MySQL, S3Tables (Iceberg), OpenSearch, Athena
  
**Languages:** Python, TypeScript
  
**Infrastructure and platform:** CDK, Github Actions
  
**Observability and tooling:** CloudWatch, Aikido, PostHog
  
**AI Tooling:** Claude Code, Internal MCP Server
  
  

**What you'll bring:**  

**Infrastructure and platform:** Hands-on experience with AWS (or equivalent cloud). Containerization (Docker), Infrastructure as Code (CDK or Terraform), and CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions).
  
**API design and development:** Hands-on experience designing and maintaining APIs, including REST (OpenAPI) and GraphQL, with a focus on consistency, versioning, and developer experience.
  
**Software engineering:** Strong proficiency in Python (or similar), including writing robust, testable, and maintainable code; familiarity with async programming patterns.
  
**Architecture:** Creating systems that scale both in performance, and maintenance.
  
**AI Tooling:** Integrates AI tooling effectively into daily workflows. Is actively trying new tooling and following new trends in the AI space.
  
**Collaboration and communication:** You enjoy collaborating both with your nearest team and with other teams. You are comfortable sharing knowledge and best practices.
  
**Site reliability and operations:** Experience defining and tracking SLOs/SLIs in large scale systems.
  
**Cloud microservices:** Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservice architectures using AWS services such as SQS, Lambda, Fargate/ECS (or close equivalents in another cloud).
  
**Location:** Based in Stockholm, within commuting distance from our office in central Stockholm.
  
**Please note:** We are currently unable to sponsor visa applications. Therefore, applicants must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.
  
Application.
  
We review applications on a rolling basis and will close the vacancy as soon as the position has been filled. Applications are accepted exclusively through Teamtailor.
  
For more information about what to expect, please read about our recruitment process here.

title: Redovisningsekonom med ERP-intresse - Linköpingsområdet
description:

title: Cloud Architect Stockholm - Hybrid

title: Redovisningsekonom med ERP-intresse

Rollen passar dig som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan redovisning, affärssystem och förbättringsarbete. Du får arbeta nära en pågående IFS Cloud-implementering i en produktnära, internationell tillverkningsmiljö där kvalitet i ekonomiflödena har direkt betydelse för verksamheten.

title: Redovisningsekonom med fokus på ERP och verksamhetsutveckling
description:
Vill du kombinera redovisning med system, processutveckling och förbättringsarbete? Nu söker vi en redovisningsekonom till ett internationellt industribolag i västra Östergötland. Du får en central roll i företagets pågående implementering av ett nytt affärssystem och möjlighet att långsiktigt utvecklas inom både redovisning och systemförvaltning.
  
Dina arbetsuppgifterSom redovisningsekonom blir du en del av ekonomifunktionen och arbetar nära både ekonomiavdelningen och teamet som ansvarar för implementeringen av företagets nya affärssystem, IFS Cloud.
  
Inledningsvis ligger rollens huvudsakliga fokus på ERP-implementeringen. Du deltar i testning, verifiering och kvalitetssäkring samt bidrar till att utveckla ekonomiska processer och flöden i det nya systemet. Du arbetar även med att sätta upp data, kunder, attribut och andra systemrelaterade parametrar.
  
På sikt kommer du att vara delaktig i utrullningen av systemet till koncernens dotterbolag och stötta verksamheten i implementeringsarbetet. När systemet är på plats övergår rollen successivt till att även omfatta mer traditionellt redovisningsarbete, finansiell uppföljning och förvaltning av systemets redovisningsmodul.
  
  

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**  

Delta aktivt i implementeringen av IFS Cloud
  
Testa, verifiera och kvalitetssäkra ekonomiska flöden
  
Utveckla processer och arbetssätt inom ekonomiområdet
  
Sätta upp kunder, attribut och systemrelaterade parametrar
  
Arbeta nära ekonomi- och implementeringsteamet
  
Bidra till att driva implementeringsprojektet framåt
  
Delta i utrullningen av systemet till koncernens dotterbolag
  
Stötta verksamheten i system- och processrelaterade frågor
  
Arbeta med löpande redovisning och finansiell uppföljning
  
På sikt ta ett superuseransvar för systemets redovisningsmodul
  
Din profil
  
Vi söker dig som har minst två års erfarenhet som redovisningsekonom och goda kunskaper inom redovisning. Du har tidigare arbetat inom tillverkande industri, vilket är ett krav för rollen. Därigenom har du fått en god förståelse för hur ekonomiska flöden hänger samman med exempelvis lagerhantering, materialflöden och produktion.
  
Du har god vana av att arbeta i olika ERP- eller affärssystem och ett stort intresse för system, dataflöden och processutveckling. Vi tror att du tycker att förbättringsarbete är minst lika intressant som den traditionella redovisningen.
  
Vidare har du goda kunskaper i Excel och kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  
  

**Det är meriterande om du har:**  

Deltagit i en ERP-implementering
  
Erfarenhet av affärssystembyten eller större förändringsprojekt
  
Arbetat som superuser eller key user inom ekonomi
  
Erfarenhet av IFS Cloud
  
  

Som person är du driven, initiativtagande och van att ta ansvar för att föra ditt arbete framåt. Du är nyfiken och tycker om att förstå hur system, data, processer och verksamhet hänger ihop. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och noggrant och är trygg i att planera och genomföra dina arbetsuppgifter självständigt.
  
Du trivs i en föränderlig miljö och motiveras av att bidra till utveckling och långsiktiga förbättringar.
  
Om företagetVår kund är ett väletablerat och familjeägt industribolag med en stark internationell närvaro. Företaget utvecklar och tillverkar tekniskt avancerade produkter och befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas där digitalisering, effektiva processer och långsiktiga förbättringar står i fokus.
  
Företagskulturen präglas av utveckling, ansvarstagande, samarbete och lärande. Här får du möjlighet att växa i din roll och samtidigt bidra till ett omfattande förändringsprojekt med stor betydelse för hela verksamheten.
  
**Om uppdragetPlacering:** Västra Östergötland
  
**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse
  
**Omfattning:** Heltid
  
  

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag där du inledningsvis blir anställd av OIO och arbetar hos vår kund. Kundens ambition är att efter cirka sex månader erbjuda en tillsvidareanställning.
  
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Data Scientist, Growth
description:
**TL;DR** — The first data scientist in our new London growth team. You own the growth funnel end to end, from acquisition to activation to retention to expansion, find the levers, and work directly with growth engineering to ship experiments into the product. Not decision support: you drive the numbers.

**Why Lovable?**
================


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* A growth-minded data scientist who owns funnel outcomes: you find the lever, run the experiment, and drive the metric, working shoulder to shoulder with growth engineers.
* Deep instinct for acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion, and what actually moves them.
* Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and heavy experimentation (A/B and growth tests) in a fast-moving environment.
* You build the systems and agents that surface growth opportunities proactively, not one-off analyses.
* Comfortable shipping fast with directional reads, and knowing when rigor matters.
* Entrepreneurial and autonomous. Excited to be first in seat and shape how growth data works at Lovable.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own the growth funnel metrics end to end and drive measurable improvement across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion.
* Find the highest-leverage opportunities in the funnel and turn them into experiments that ship, working directly with growth engineering.
* Design, run, and read growth experiments, and act on them.
* Build the instrumentation, metrics, and agents the growth team runs on.
* Help shape the growth data function as its first data scientist.

**Our tech stack**
==================


We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

* **Languages:** SQL and Python
* **Warehouse & events:** BigQuery, PubSub
* **Analytics & product:** Hex, Lovable Apps
* **Experimentation:** A/B and growth testing
* **Cloud:** GCP


And always on the lookout for what's next.

**How we hire**
===============

* Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
* A call with the hiring manager
* A take-home case study
* A Most Impressive Project session
* Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
* A final conversation with leadership

**About your application**
==========================


Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.


We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our Data Center of Excellence (CoE) team at Betsson Group. You'll design, build, and deploy AI and agentic solutions with real business impact, from LLM-driven pipelines to intelligent automation, while helping shape our technical direction. If you're passionate about applied AI and enjoy turning emerging research into production-grade systems, we'd love to hear from you!

  

**The Wow**
-----------



You'll be at the forefront of AI innovation in iGaming - a space where cutting-edge technology meets real-time, high-stakes decision-making. As part of our Data CoE, you'll take ownership of complex AI initiatives end-to-end, from architecture to deployment, working closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into production-grade solutions. You'll have the autonomy to solve hard problems independently, the platform to influence how AI is adopted across the business, and the opportunity to share your expertise with the wider team.

  


**A taster of what you will be involved with:**
-----------------------------------------------



Expect to independently design, build, and deploy LLM-powered pipelines and autonomous agents that solve real operational challenges from intelligent automation to advanced retrieval systems. You'll work closely with stakeholders to scope and deliver solutions, get hands-on with frameworks like LangChain, and help set best practices around MLOps and production-grade AI. You'll also have opportunities to mentor developers and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing as part of a well-rounded senior role.

  


**What we are looking for:**

The ideal candidate must have the following:


* BSc/MSc in CS, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field
* 3+ years industry experience designing, building and deploying Generative AI solutions
* Strong proficiency in Python

* Experience integrating and orchestrating LLM-based pipelines end-to-end

The following are preferred but not required:


* Familiarity with cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure Open AI)
* Experience with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA)
* Experience in building advanced knowledge retrieval systems including Knowledge Graphs and Context Graphs
* Previous experience in iGaming industry

  


**What we offer**

Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you're a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you'll fit right in.

  


**Challenge accepted?**
-----------------------
